65683.recognize_zh: 這是腹部冠狀切面的 MRI 影像（非敘述中寫的 CT），量測顯示肝臟長徑約 181.8 mm、脾臟約 129.5 mm，皆明顯增大；肝脾腫大支持肝硬化合併門脈高壓，是棘狀紅血球貧血（spur cell anemia）的臨床背景，但影像本身不能診斷溶血。
features: Coronal cross-sectional abdominal MR image (signal characteristics and bright subcutaneous fat indicate MRI rather than CT)
Hepatomegaly with measured craniocaudal liver span of 181.8 mm
Splenomegaly with measured splenic length of 129.5 mm
Liver appears relatively hypointense compared with spleen on this sequence; surface nodularity cannot be reliably assessed at this resolution
65683.describe_en: This is a radiologic image, a coronal abdominal MR image, rather than a blood smear; the case description refers to CT, but the image characteristics are those of MRI. It demonstrates hepatomegaly (craniocaudal span 181.8 mm) and splenomegaly (splenic length 129.5 mm). Relative hypointensity of the liver is noted but should not be over-interpreted on a single sequence, and cirrhotic surface nodularity cannot be reliably assessed here. Hepatosplenomegaly in advanced liver disease provides the clinical context for spur cell anemia, in which altered lipid composition produces acanthocytes that are removed by the enlarged spleen; the diagnosis itself rests on the peripheral smear and hemolysis parameters.

65811.recognize_zh: 白血球數量極多，同一視野裡骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核與分節嗜中性球都有，成熟過程連續且無明顯發育不良，中間可見一顆含橘紅色顆粒的嗜伊紅性球，符合 CML 慢性期的周邊血液像。
features: Marked leukocytosis with a continuous spectrum of granulocytic maturation
Myelocytes predominate: round to oval nuclei, partially condensed chromatin, lilac secondary granules
Metamyelocytes and bands with indented to horseshoe nuclei, plus mature segmented neutrophils
A single eosinophil with orange refractile granules centrally
Blasts not increased; no hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger-Huet nuclei
Numerous platelets; normocytic normochromic red cells
65811.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with granulocytes at all stages of maturation, predominantly myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. An eosinophil is present, blasts are not increased in this field, and there is no significant granulocytic dysplasia. Platelets are abundant and red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: Reactive left shift has toxic granulation, Dohle bodies and few myelocytes, without eosinophilia or basophilia.
aCML shows marked dysgranulopoiesis and no basophilia, while maturation here is orderly.
CNL is dominated by mature segmented neutrophils with fewer than 10% circulating immature granulocytes.

65555.recognize_zh: 這是軸狀面增強後 MRI：橘色箭頭指向中腦被蓋區（影像右側，即病人左側）一個小的點狀顯影病灶，在骨髓瘤病人要想到中樞神經髓外病灶（CNS EMD）；這是影像而非形態學圖片。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced T1-weighted brain MRI at the level of the midbrain
Small punctate enhancing focus in the left midbrain tegmentum (orange arrow)
No mass effect or surrounding edema appreciable on this single slice
No obvious dural or leptomeningeal thickening on this slice
Imaging alone cannot establish plasma cell origin
65555.describe_en: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted MRI of the brain demonstrates a small, punctate enhancing focus in the left midbrain tegmentum (arrow), without appreciable mass effect on this image. No definite dural-based mass or leptomeningeal enhancement is evident on this single slice. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, this is suggestive of central nervous system extramedullary disease, which should be confirmed by CSF cytology (plasma cells on cytospin) and flow cytometry, as vascular, infectious, and demyelinating lesions can appear similar.

65171.recognize_zh: CD56 對側向散射的散佈圖中，紫色主要族群呈強 CD56 陽性（約 10^2）且側向散射低到中等，與 CD56 陰性、高側向散射的顆粒球分開，支持神經內分泌來源的腫瘤細胞（如神經母細胞瘤）。
features: Ungated CD56 vs SS plot with a dominant highlighted population showing bright CD56 expression (about 10^2)
The CD56-bright population has low to intermediate side scatter
Gray CD56-negative high side scatter cluster corresponding to granulocytes
Small CD56-negative low side scatter population (residual lymphoid/other cells)
Large proportion of events in the CD56-bright cluster, indicating heavy marrow infiltration
65171.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the bone marrow shows a dominant population with bright CD56 expression and low to intermediate side scatter, distinct from the CD56-negative granulocytes with high side scatter. When correlated with the CD45-negative gating of the same population, this indicates a CD45-negative, CD56-bright non-hematopoietic cell population. CD56 is not lineage specific, so confirmation with GD2 or morphology/immunohistochemistry is needed. Findings are consistent with bone marrow infiltration by metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.dx: NK-cell neoplasm or CD56-positive hematolymphoid neoplasm
ddx.vs: NK cells and CD56-positive myeloma or AML are CD45-positive (myeloma CD138/CD38-bright), whereas this population is CD45-negative.
BPDCN is CD56-positive but CD45 dim-positive with CD4, CD123 and TCF4 expression.
These CD45-negative tumors can express CD56, so GD2 positivity by flow or PHOX2B/synaptophysin by IHC is required to favor neuroblastoma.

65235.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被纖維化間質填滿，裡面可見多個小巢狀與腺管樣排列的上皮細胞團，核深染擁擠，完全沒有造血細胞，符合乳腺管癌轉移至骨髓。
features: Intertrabecular space between thick bony trabeculae filled with fibroblastic desmoplastic stroma
Multiple small cohesive nests and cord-like or gland-like clusters of epithelial cells
Crowded hyperchromatic nuclei with moderate cytoplasm
Retraction clefts around tumor nests
No residual hematopoietic cells or fat in the involved space
65235.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an intertrabecular space filled with desmoplastic fibrous stroma containing multiple small cohesive nests and cords of epithelial cells, some with vague gland-like arrangement. The tumor cells have crowded hyperchromatic nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, with retraction clefts around the nests. Residual hematopoiesis is not identified in the involved area. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow, compatible with the patient's known invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast.

ddx.vs: Lobular carcinoma cells are discohesive, often single-file, and lose E-cadherin, unlike these cohesive nests.
Morphology overlaps, so GATA3/ER/HER2 positivity supports breast origin versus TTF-1, CDX2 or PSA/NKX3.1 for other sites.
Megakaryocytes are large single cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei, CD61-positive, not keratin-positive nests.

65363.recognize_zh: A 圖血片呈雙相性，部分紅血球明顯大小不均、低色素；箭頭所指的淡色紅血球內有一團深藍色、均質圓形的包涵體（聚集的過量 α 鏈），B 圖以 methyl violet 超活體染色可見大塊紫色包涵體，符合脾切除後 β 型地中海貧血的 Fessas bodies。
features: Dimorphic red cell population with marked anisopoikilocytosis, hypochromic cells and target cells
Pale red cells containing a single large, dense, homogeneous deep-blue round inclusion (arrows)
Occasional small basophilic dots in red cells, possibly Pappenheimer or Howell-Jolly bodies post-splenectomy
Panel B: supravital methyl violet stain highlights large, dense purple intracellular inclusions (arrows)
Panel B: neutrophil and ghost-like red cells in the supravital preparation
65363.describe_en: Composite figure. The May-Grünwald-Giemsa peripheral blood smear is dimorphic, with a population of normochromic transfused-appearing red cells and a population showing marked anisopoikilocytosis, hypochromia and target cells. Several pale red cells contain a single large, dense, round deep-blue inclusion. A supravital methyl violet preparation highlights these as large dense intracellular inclusions. In a splenectomized patient with transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia, findings are consistent with Fessas bodies (precipitated α-globin chain aggregates).

ddx.vs: HbH (β4) inclusions appear as multiple fine, evenly distributed 'golf ball' dots with brilliant cresyl blue rather than one large dense aggregate.
Heinz bodies are small, peripheral, membrane-attached inclusions on supravital stain, typically with bite cells in oxidant hemolysis.
Howell-Jolly bodies are small (about 1 µm) round dark-purple nuclear remnants, much smaller than the large globin aggregates seen here.
An NRBC has a nucleus with chromatin texture and surrounding cytoplasm, whereas Fessas bodies are homogeneous, structureless inclusions in an otherwise pale cell.

65299.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量淋巴球，但細胞比典型 CLL 大、細胞質較豐富淡藍，核形不規則、有凹陷或切跡，上方還有破碎的 smudge cell；這種「非典型 CLL 形態」常與第 12 號染色體三體（trisomy 12）相關。
features: Absolute lymphocytosis of small-to-medium lymphocytes
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm, larger than classic CLL cells
Irregular, notched and focally cleaved nuclear contours
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Smudge (basket) cells present at the top of the field
Normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
65299.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis. The lymphocytes are small to medium sized, with more abundant pale cytoplasm than typical CLL cells, irregular to notched nuclear outlines, and moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; smudge cells are present. Prolymphocytes are not conspicuous in this field. The findings represent atypical CLL morphology, which is associated with trisomy 12, and require immunophenotypic confirmation (CD5+, CD23+, dim sIg).

ddx.vs: MCL cells also have irregular or cleaved nuclei but are CD23-negative, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and carry t(11;14), which flow cytometry and FISH resolve.
SMZL cells often have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are typically CD5-negative and CD23-negative.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are larger with a single prominent central nucleolus, which is not a feature of most cells here.

65107.recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍 CD138 免疫染色：濾泡本身陰性，濾泡間區被大量成片的 CD138 陽性漿細胞撐開、環繞濾泡分布，呈現 Castleman 病漿細胞型的濾泡間漿細胞增生。
features: Low-power architecture with multiple CD138-negative follicles, several small/regressed
Interfollicular areas expanded by dense sheets and cords of CD138-positive plasma cells
Plasma cells encircle follicles in a band-like, anastomosing pattern
Germinal centers and mantle zones negative, with blue counterstain
65107.describe_en: Lymph node section immunostained for CD138 at low power shows preserved nodal architecture with multiple CD138-negative follicles, some small and regressed. The interfollicular areas are markedly expanded by dense sheets and cords of CD138-positive plasma cells that encircle the follicles. The plasmablasts of HHV8-associated MCD are typically CD138-negative and are not specifically highlighted by this stain. Findings are consistent with a marked interfollicular plasmacytosis as seen in the plasma cell pattern of multicentric Castleman disease; light-chain and HHV8 stains are needed for further classification.

ddx.dx: Nodal involvement by plasma cell neoplasm (extraosseous plasmacytoma)
ddx.vs: Plasmacytoma shows diffuse effacement by monotypic plasma cells, whereas here architecture is preserved and the plasma cells are interfollicular; kappa/lambda ISH resolves clonality.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: NMZL shows marginal zone B-cell expansion with colonized follicles and light-chain-restricted plasma cells rather than regressed follicles with polytypic interfollicular plasma cells.

ddx.dx: IgG4-related lymphadenopathy or reactive plasmacytosis (autoimmune, syphilis)
ddx.vs: These lack HHV8 and show increased IgG4+ cells or a spirochete/clinical context rather than LANA-1-positive plasmablasts.

64979.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆巨大的巨核細胞，核分成許多分散、深染的小葉（過度分葉 hyperlobated），細胞質豐富淡紫色，周圍背景細胞密度很高，符合 JAK2 陽性真性紅血球增多症（PV）中大型、多葉的巨核細胞。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with abundant pale granular lilac cytoplasm and smooth border
Hyperlobated nucleus with numerous discrete, loosely connected lobes
Lobes with moderately condensed chromatin; no micromegakaryocytic or hypolobated features
Surrounding hypercellular aspirate with erythroid and myeloid precursors
Adjacent stromal/cellular fragment at the top of the field
64979.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and contains a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a hyperlobated nucleus composed of many loosely connected lobes. No hypolobated or micromegakaryocytic forms are seen in this field. Background shows panmyelosis with abundant erythroid and granulocytic precursors. In a patient with a JAK2 mutation, findings are consistent with the enlarged, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes seen in polycythemia vera; trephine biopsy is needed to assess megakaryocyte clustering and fibrosis.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are also large and hyperlobated (staghorn) but occur without panmyelosis or erythroid expansion and with normal hemoglobin.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like, hypolobated nuclei and dense clustering, often with reticulin fibrosis.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normal-sized with normal lobation and there is no JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation.
Megaloblastic megakaryocytes may be hyperlobated but coexist with megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.

64723.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一個血管腔內有捲曲、帶狀、呈顆粒狀嗜鹼性（淡紫藍色）且無細胞的異物，周圍有少量纖維化基質與多核巨細胞，符合導管來源的親水性聚合物栓子（hydrophilic polymer embolus）。
features: Serpiginous, ribbon-like, folded acellular deposit of lightly granular basophilic material within a vascular space
Material is homogeneous-granular, nonrefractile, with small clear vacuoles at its edges
Few multinucleated foreign-body-type giant cells at the lower edge of the deposit
Surrounding loose fibrous/edematous stroma with scattered mononuclear cells
Background fatty marrow with bony trabecula; no necrosis or infarct in this field
64723.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a predominantly fatty marrow space adjacent to a bony trabecula. Within a vascular space there is a coiled, serpiginous, ribbon-like deposit of acellular, finely granular, pale basophilic material, surrounded by loose fibrous stroma and a few multinucleated foreign-body giant cells. There is no associated necrosis, infarct, or neoplastic infiltrate in this field. In a patient with prior endovascular catheterization, findings are consistent with a hydrophilic polymer (catheter coating) embolus.

ddx.vs: Calcium is dark purple, glassy-to-fractured and often refractile, whereas polymer emboli are pale, granular, basophilic laminated ribbons within vessels.
Fungi show discrete septate or pauciseptate hyphal walls highlighted by GMS/PAS, whereas this material is amorphous and laminated without true hyphal structures.
Cholesterol emboli leave biconvex needle-shaped clefts in arterioles rather than solid basophilic serpiginous material.
Gelatinous transformation is a pale, extravascular, finely fibrillary interstitial substance around atrophic fat, not a coiled intravascular deposit with giant cells.

64531.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小與形狀極度不一：可見標靶細胞、淚滴狀、碎片、摺疊細胞與低色素小紅血球，還有少數含深色包涵體的紅血球，這種明顯的異形紅血球症（poikilocytosis）在 β-海洋性貧血重型很常見。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous bizarre red cell shapes
Target cells, folded cells, teardrop cells, and red cell fragments
Hypochromic microcytes alongside larger pale cells
Occasional red cells with small dark inclusions (possible Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer bodies)
Occasional crenated cell; platelets scattered; no leukocytes in field
64531.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic microcytes, target cells, folded cells, teardrop cells, and red cell fragments. A few red cells contain small dark inclusions compatible with Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer bodies. Platelets are present and no leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with severe poikilocytosis, compatible with the reported β-thalassemia major; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC is appropriate.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes and pencil cells with fewer target cells and fragments, low ferritin, and a normal HbA2.
HbH disease has a similar smear but shows golf-ball inclusions on brilliant cresyl blue supravital stain and HbH on electrophoresis.
MAHA shows schistocytes with thrombocytopenia but typically normochromic cells without the prominent target cells and hypochromia.
HPP shows elliptocytes and microspherocytes with budding fragments rather than target cells, with a normal hemoglobin pattern.

64467.recognize_zh: 痰液抹片中可見成群、大小一致的小圓形體（約為中性球的一半以下），聚集在泡沫狀、無結構的物質裡，部分可見深色點狀內容物，符合肺囊蟲（Pneumocystis jirovecii）囊體簇；但影像失焦、染色偏紅，細節有限。
features: Clusters and streams of numerous small, uniform round bodies (roughly 4-6 µm), much smaller than adjacent neutrophils
Bodies are aggregated within amorphous, foamy background material
Some bodies show dark central or peripheral dot-like content (possible intracystic bodies)
Scattered neutrophils present; no budding forms or hyphae identified
Image is soft-focus with an intensely pink-red stain cast, limiting fine structural detail
64467.describe_en: Sputum smear (composite of three fields) shows clusters and linear streams of numerous small, uniform round bodies embedded in amorphous, foamy material, with scattered neutrophils. Some of the round bodies contain dark dot-like internal structures, and no budding yeast or hyphae are seen. Focus and stain quality limit detailed evaluation, so confirmation with a cyst wall stain (GMS or toluidine blue), immunofluorescence, or PCR is recommended. In an HIV-positive patient, findings are consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii cysts.

ddx.vs: Yeasts show budding (narrow-based for Histoplasma, pseudohyphae for Candida) and are often intracellular, whereas Pneumocystis cysts are non-budding and extracellular in foamy casts.

ddx.dx: Red blood cells or erythrocyte ghosts
ddx.vs: Red cells are larger (about 7-8 µm), biconcave and lack internal dot-like bodies.
Bacterial cocci are about 1 µm, far smaller than these round bodies, and lack internal structure.

64275.recognize_zh: 低倍圓形視野中有數個大型、立體重疊的細胞團，細胞核大、核質比高、排列擁擠並互相擠壓，與左側單個良性間皮細胞及散在的小淋巴球大小差異明顯，符合肺癌轉移至肋膜積液。
features: Several cohesive three-dimensional clusters of large cells with crowded, overlapping nuclei
High N:C ratio with enlarged round to oval hyperchromatic nuclei and nuclear molding
Basophilic cytoplasm with frayed, finely vacuolated edges on some groups
Isolated benign mesothelial cell with central nucleus and pale cytoplasm for size comparison (left)
Scattered lymphocytes and occasional red cells in a clean background
64275.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin at low to intermediate power shows several cohesive, three-dimensional clusters of large atypical cells with crowded, overlapping hyperchromatic nuclei and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. These groups contrast with a single benign-appearing mesothelial cell and scattered small lymphocytes in the background. Nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the pleural fluid in a patient with known lung cancer, with cell block immunocytochemistry recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive mesothelial groups are flat or papillary with intercellular windows, low N:C ratio and uniform nuclei, and are calretinin/WT1 positive and Ber-EP4/MOC-31 negative.
Mesothelioma can form cell balls but is calretinin, WT1 and D2-40 positive with BAP1 loss, whereas lung adenocarcinoma is TTF-1 and MOC-31 positive.
Small cell carcinoma shows smaller cells with scant cytoplasm, finely granular chromatin, prominent molding in chains and absent nucleoli.

64019.recognize_zh: 這是右大腿近端的CT橫切面（非形態學圖片），股骨內後側有一團與骨皮質相連、密度如骨的不規則團塊，測量約81.4 x 44.5 mm，符合血友病A病人的異位性骨化。
features: Axial contrast CT of the proximal thighs with the right side marked
Dense, irregular ossified mass arising adjacent to the medial/posterior cortex of the right proximal femur
Calipers measure the lesion at approximately 81.4 x 44.5 mm
Mottled internal mineralization at the periphery extending into adjacent muscle
Right femoral medullary cavity preserved; no large fluid-density collection seen
64019.describe_en: Axial CT image through the proximal thighs shows a dense, irregular bone-density mass contiguous with the medial/posterior aspect of the right proximal femur, extending into the adjacent adductor compartment and measuring approximately 81.4 x 44.5 mm. The femoral medullary cavity is preserved and there is no large fluid-density collection or overt cortical destruction on this slice. In a patient with hemophilia A, the findings are consistent with heterotopic ossification secondary to prior intramuscular hemorrhage. This is a radiologic image; histologic features cannot be assessed.

ddx.vs: Pseudotumors are encapsulated hematomas of mixed fluid density that erode bone, rather than a mature ossified mass.

Parosteal osteosarcoma is densest at its base with a cleavage plane along the cortex and progressive growth, while heterotopic ossification shows peripheral maturation and a relevant bleeding history; biopsy is decisive if doubt remains.
Osteochondromas show continuity of both cortex and medullary cavity with the parent bone and a cartilage cap.

63891.recognize_zh: 兩張照片是放在藍色手術巾上的一條約 5 cm 長、暗紅水腫的腸黏膜片段，周圍有膽汁／糞便染色的液體；這是異體移植後排出的腸黏膜，肉眼只能看出嚴重黏膜損傷，無法單憑外觀確認是 GVHD。
features: Gross photograph of an elongated, tubular tissue fragment on a blue surgical drape (A: overview, B: closer view)
Dark red, hemorrhagic and edematous mucosal surface with a glistening appearance
Irregular, excavated and frayed edges suggesting sloughed mucosa
Surrounding yellow-green to brown staining consistent with bile-tinged fecal fluid and blood
No scale bar; no histologic detail available
63891.describe_en: Gross photographs show an expelled elongated fragment of intestinal-type tissue, approximately 5 cm per history, that is dark red, edematous and hemorrhagic with irregular excavated edges, lying in bile- and blood-stained fecal material. These appearances indicate extensive mucosal sloughing. The gross image alone cannot establish the cause; in a recent allogeneic HSCT recipient the differential includes severe acute gastrointestinal GVHD and conditioning-related mucositis, and histologic examination for crypt apoptosis, crypt dropout and infection is required.

ddx.vs: Toxic mucositis appears in the first days after myeloablative conditioning and histologically shows diffuse epithelial atypia without the crypt-base apoptotic bodies and crypt dropout that define acute GVHD, which typically appears after engraftment.
CMV shows enlarged endothelial/stromal cells with owl-eye intranuclear inclusions confirmed by CMV immunohistochemistry, which gross inspection cannot show.
Neutropenic enterocolitis centers on the cecum with transmural edema, necrosis and bacterial invasion on imaging and histology rather than diffuse crypt apoptosis.
C. difficile produces yellow-white adherent pseudomembranes with volcano-like exudates and a positive toxin assay, unlike a sloughed hemorrhagic mucosal cast.

63763.recognize_zh: A 抹片見大量小型成熟淋巴球，核圓、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質稀少；B 低倍切片骨髓細胞增多並有瀰漫性間質浸潤；C 高倍見小圓淋巴球穿插於殘存造血細胞與巨核細胞之間，符合 CLL 骨髓侵犯。
features: Aspirate (A): numerous small lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm; occasional smudged cells
Biopsy low power (B): hypercellular marrow for age with diffuse interstitial infiltrate replacing fat
Biopsy high power (C): small round lymphocytes with dark nuclei infiltrating between residual hematopoietic cells
Residual megakaryocyte and erythroid/myeloid elements preserved in C
No proliferation centers or large transformed cells evident in these fields
63763.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (A) shows a marked increase in small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, with occasional smudged cells. The core biopsy (B) is hypercellular with a diffuse interstitial lymphoid infiltrate, and at high power (C) small round lymphocytes are interspersed between residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes. Large transformed cells and expanded proliferation centers are not identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia in a diffuse pattern, which is associated with more advanced disease.

ddx.vs: Cells have irregular nuclear contours and are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive, CD23 negative on immunohistochemistry.
Infiltrate includes plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, often with increased mast cells and an IgM paraprotein.
Reactive infiltrates are focal, non-paratrabecular and polytypic, while hematogones are immature TdT/CD10-positive precursors.
Would show sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, absent here.

63699.recognize_zh: 中央分葉核嗜中性球的細胞質中，核葉旁有一根細長、粉紫色的針狀包涵體（Auer rod）；成熟嗜中性球內出現 Auer rod 代表它屬於腫瘤性髓系細胞。
features: Mature neutrophil with lobulated nucleus and clumped chromatin
Single slender, needle-shaped, pink-purple rod-like inclusion in the cytoplasm adjacent to a nuclear lobe
Pale cytoplasm with sparse fine granules (relatively hypogranular)
No blasts in this field
Background red cells normocytic with central pallor; scattered platelets
63699.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a single slender, needle-like azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with an Auer rod. The neutrophil cytoplasm appears relatively hypogranular. Red cells are unremarkable and no blasts are present in this limited field. Auer rods within maturing neutrophils indicate that the neutrophil derives from the neoplastic myeloid clone; in the given setting of acute myeloid leukemia, this is typical of AML with maturation such as AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 or APL after ATRA, and correlation with blast count and genetic studies is required.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale blue, irregular patches at the cytoplasmic periphery rather than a sharp pink-purple needle-shaped rod.
Toxic granulation is diffuse coarse dark granules throughout the cytoplasm, not a single linear crystalline inclusion.
Precipitate lies above the cell out of focus and is not confined to the cytoplasm; a true Auer rod is intracytoplasmic and MPO positive.
Chédiak-Higashi inclusions are large round granules present in most neutrophils, not a slender rod in a single cell.

63635.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一群大型異常細胞，細胞核有明顯的中央摺痕，呈雙葉或蝴蝶形（bilobed/butterfly nucleus），細胞質少且幾乎看不到顆粒，這是急性前骨髓細胞白血病微顆粒型（APL, hypogranular/microgranular variant）的典型表現。
features: Cluster of large abnormal cells with high N:C ratio in peripheral blood
Nuclei deeply folded with a central groove, producing bilobed, butterfly- or dumbbell-shaped contours
Moderately fine chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Scant to moderate cytoplasm with few or no visible granules (microgranular); no Auer rods or faggot cells seen in this field
Background normocytic red cells with no platelets conspicuous
63635.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of large atypical cells with high N:C ratio and characteristic deeply folded, bilobed to butterfly-shaped nuclei with moderately fine chromatin. The cytoplasm is scant and appears largely agranular at light-microscopic resolution, and no Auer rods or faggot cells are identified in this field. Platelets are not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular (hypogranular) variant; this is a medical emergency, and urgent coagulation studies, strong MPO confirmation and PML::RARA testing are indicated.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei too, but abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, are MPO weak/negative, nonspecific esterase positive and HLA-DR positive, whereas APL is strongly MPO+ and HLA-DR negative.
Classic APL shows abundant coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus and frequent faggot cells, while the microgranular variant appears nearly agranular.
Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei with condensed chromatin and are MPO-negative, CD4+ T cells.
Cup-like blasts have a single nuclear invagination rather than bilobed folding and lack PML::RARA.

63571.recognize_zh: 血片中到處都是一端拉尖的淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocytes），並可見未成熟的骨髓球（myelocyte）與偏多的血小板，這種白紅血球母細胞樣（leukoerythroblastic）變化加上淚滴細胞，強烈提示骨髓纖維化。
features: Numerous teardrop poikilocytes (dacrocytes) with single tapered tails
Anisopoikilocytosis with occasional larger polychromatic red cells
Circulating immature granulocytes: myelocytes with round-oval nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Mature segmented neutrophil also present
Platelets appear increased, with some variation in size including enlarged forms
63571.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells (dacrocytes) and mild anisocytosis with scattered polychromatic macrocytes. Immature granulocytes, including myelocytes, are present alongside mature neutrophils, indicating a leukoerythroblastic picture; nucleated red cells are not seen in this field. Platelets appear increased with some size variation. No blasts are identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of primary myelofibrosis; bone marrow biopsy with reticulin staining and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are recommended.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or other marrow infiltration (myelophthisis)
ddx.vs: Myelophthisic anemia produces the same leukoerythroblastic picture with dacrocytes, so marrow biopsy showing tumor cells rather than atypical megakaryocytes with driver mutations is needed.
Morphology is identical; the distinction depends on a documented prior history of PV or ET.
CML shows a much higher leukocytosis with a full spectrum of granulocytes, basophilia and few teardrop cells, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
These produce dacrocytes but with target cells/microcytosis or oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, without circulating myelocytes and thrombocytosis.

63443.recognize_zh: 薄層血片中箭頭指出兩隻位於紅血球之間的細長鞭毛蟲，蟲體呈 C 或 U 字形彎曲，後端有一顆大而明顯的動基體（kinetoplast），前端拖出游離鞭毛，這是克氏錐蟲（T. cruzi）血流型錐鞭毛體（trypomastigote）的典型樣貌。
features: Extracellular flagellated protozoa lying between red cells (arrows)
Slender body curved into a C or U shape
Large, prominent terminal (posterior) kinetoplast
Central nucleus with a narrow undulating membrane and free anterior flagellum
Background red cells unremarkable with scattered platelets
63443.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows extracellular flagellated protozoa lying between red cells. The organisms have slender bodies curved in a C- or U-shape, a centrally placed nucleus, a large prominent posterior kinetoplast, and a free anterior flagellum. The background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Trypanosoma cruzi bloodstream trypomastigotes, as seen in acute Chagas disease.

ddx.vs: T. brucei trypomastigotes have a small subterminal kinetoplast, a prominent undulating membrane, and are less often C-shaped, and may show dividing forms in blood.
T. rangeli is longer and more slender with a small subterminal kinetoplast and is non-pathogenic.
Microfilariae are much larger multicellular worms with a column of nuclei and no kinetoplast or flagellum.
Borrelia are thin, loosely coiled spirochetes without a nucleus, kinetoplast, or undulating membrane.

63379.recognize_zh: 中央一個巨噬細胞的胞質裡有十來個小點狀物，另有數個散在紅血球之間；每個小體呈「雙點」外觀（核加 kinetoplast），符合骨髓抹片中的 LD bodies。
features: Histiocyte with pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing about a dozen tiny oval organisms
Organisms show a characteristic double-dot appearance (nucleus plus kinetoplast)
Additional free amastigotes scattered between red cells
Background hematopoietic cells including plasma cells, a neutrophil and erythroid precursors
Image somewhat soft-focus; kinetoplast detail best appreciated at higher magnification
63379.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed hematopoietic elements, including plasma cells and neutrophils. A central macrophage contains multiple small oval intracytoplasmic organisms, and similar organisms lie free between red cells. The organisms show a nucleus with an adjacent kinetoplast producing a double-dot appearance, without capsules or budding. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies).

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo and budding and lack the paired kinetoplast dot.
Talaromyces shows elongated forms with a central septum from fission rather than a nucleus-kinetoplast pair.
Debris and platelets are irregular in size and shape and lack a uniform oval body with a second small dot.

63315.recognize_zh: 中央大型細胞的胞質呈淡藍色、充滿纖維狀條紋（像「皺褶的絹紙」wrinkled tissue paper），核偏心，背景為增生的顆粒球系與嗜酸性顆粒，符合 CML 骨髓中的偽高雪氏細胞（pseudo-Gaucher cell）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue cytoplasm filled with fine fibrillary, striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' material
Single round, eccentric nucleus with coarse chromatin
Background of numerous granulocytic precursors and scattered eosinophilic granules
Adjacent megakaryocytic cells with multilobated nuclei (upper right)
63315.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular background with numerous granulocytic precursors, eosinophilic granules and megakaryocytic elements. A large histiocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fibrillary, striated 'crinkled tissue paper' inclusions and a round eccentric nucleus is present in the center of the field. These pseudo-Gaucher cells reflect lipid accumulation from increased cell turnover. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells in the setting of chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology is nearly identical; true Gaucher disease is excluded by low glucocerebrosidase activity/GBA mutation and lack of an underlying high-turnover neoplasm, and pseudo-Gaucher cells are often less strongly PAS/iron positive.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules on Giemsa rather than fibrillary striated cytoplasm.
MAC histiocytes also show striated cytoplasm but contain acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain and appear as negative images on Romanowsky stain.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated, bubbly foamy cytoplasm rather than fibrillary tissue-paper striations.

63251.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片六個高倍視野，都是中到大型、核質比高的原始細胞（blast），染色質細緻，胞質灰藍色且沒有明顯顆粒或 Auer rod。這張圖只有血液，看不到皮膚病灶，要靠流式細胞儀（CD117+、CD33+、cMPO−）確認是 AML。
features: Medium to large blasts, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Moderate to high N:C ratio with round, oval, indented or irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed, delicate chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm with occasional cytoplasmic blebs/tags; no Auer rods seen
Background red cells without a distinctive abnormality; the skin lesion named in the title is not depicted
63251.describe_en: Composite of six high-power fields from a peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts. The blasts are medium to large with moderate to high N:C ratios, round to irregular or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant to moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic blebs. No Auer rods, cytoplasmic granules or dysplastic neutrophils are identified in these fields. The image shows only the blood component; the cutaneous infiltrate referred to in the title is not depicted. Together with the reported immunophenotype (CD117+, CD33+, CD7+, HLA-DR+, cMPO-negative, CD19/CD20/CD14/CD64-negative), findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation.

ddx.vs: Agranular myeloblasts and lymphoblasts can look identical, so lineage rests on flow cytometry; CD19/CD20 negativity with CD117/CD33 expression favors myeloid lineage, and CD7 alone does not establish T lineage without cytoplasmic CD3.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules or vacuoles and folded nuclei, and express CD14/CD64, which were negative here.
Also presents with skin lesions and agranular blasts with cytoplasmic tails, but is defined by CD123, TCF4, CD4 and CD56 coexpression rather than by morphology.

63187.recognize_zh: 周邊血中多顆異常前骨髓細胞，核呈摺疊、雙葉或扭轉狀，細胞質帶細顆粒；另見數顆脆弱、核被拉扯且顆粒散開的破損細胞，符合低顆粒型 APL。
features: Medium to large abnormal promyelocytes, several forming a tight cluster
Folded, bilobed or twisted nuclei with moderately fine chromatin
Moderate cytoplasm with fine purple granulation, some cells relatively hypogranular
Several fragile, disrupted cells with stretched nuclei and dispersed granules (smudged forms)
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; platelets not evident in this field
63187.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous abnormal promyelocytes, including a tight cluster of four cells. The cells have moderate amounts of finely granular to hypogranular cytoplasm and folded, bilobed or twisted nuclei. Several fragile cells show disrupted cytoplasm with stretched nuclei and scattered granules. Platelets are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent coagulation studies and PML::RARA testing are indicated.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have grey, vacuolated cytoplasm with sparse fine granules and are strongly nonspecific esterase positive, whereas APL cells show intense MPO and PML::RARA fusion.
CLL smudge cells arise from small mature lymphocytes with no cytoplasmic granules, not from large granular cells with folded nuclei.
Classic APL has dense coarse granules obscuring the nucleus and faggot cells with Auer rod bundles, which are not prominent here.
Mature monocytes are mixed with other normal leukocytes and have abundant grey cytoplasm with lower N:C ratio, without an expanded immature granular population.

63123.recognize_zh: CD19 免疫染色中，成片中大型細胞呈強膜狀陽性，而左下殘存的造血細胞為陰性，證實骨髓內浸潤細胞為 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: IHC for CD19 on bone marrow core biopsy
Strong membranous staining of sheets of intermediate-to-large cells
Positive cells occupy most of the field, abutting bone
Residual hematopoietic cells in lower left are CD19-negative
Scattered isolated positive cells within residual marrow
63123.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD19 highlights sheets of intermediate-to-large lymphoid cells with strong membranous staining, occupying most of the marrow space adjacent to bone. The residual hematopoietic elements in the lower left are negative, serving as an internal negative control. Findings confirm extensive marrow involvement by a B-cell lymphoma, consistent with transformed follicular lymphoma in conjunction with CD10, BCL2, and Ki-67 stains.

ddx.vs: Hematogones are small, scattered interstitial cells with a maturation spectrum (CD34/TdT/CD10 variable) and do not form sheets of large atypical cells.
B-ALL is also CD19+ but blasts are TdT and often CD34 positive, with fine blastic chromatin.
Plasma cells are typically CD19-negative, CD138+ and light-chain restricted, lacking CD20.

63059.recognize_zh: 紅箭頭的細胞只有單一偏心圓核，細胞質淡藍、邊緣有不規則泡狀突起，是像漿細胞的微小巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte）；對照藍箭頭的真正漿細胞，核染色質粗、細胞質深藍且有核周淡區（hof）。
features: Micromegakaryocyte (red arrow): small cell with a single round eccentric nucleus, moderate pale-blue cytoplasm and irregular budding/blebbed cytoplasmic margins
Plasma cell (blue arrow): eccentric dense nucleus with clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Background of numerous immature granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes/myelocytes) with round to indented nuclei
Occasional hypolobated/hypogranular neutrophils and a band form
Scattered red cells and platelets
63059.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field dominated by granulocytic precursors. A small megakaryocyte with a single round eccentric nucleus and pale blue cytoplasm with irregular budding margins is present (micromegakaryocyte), mimicking a plasma cell; a nearby true plasma cell shows denser clumped chromatin and more intensely basophilic cytoplasm. Scattered neutrophils appear hypogranular. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in the setting of a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have coarse clock-face chromatin, deep basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof, whereas the micromegakaryocyte has paler cytoplasm with blebbed margins and is CD61/CD42b positive.
Blasts have fine chromatin with nucleoli and a high N:C ratio, whereas micromegakaryocytes have mature condensed chromatin and more cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Normal megakaryocyte in a reactive marrow
ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes are large with a lobulated nucleus, unlike this promyelocyte-sized mononuclear form.

62995.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑之間大片被淡粉紅色、富含膠原的紡錘形細胞浸潤取代，並與骨小樑緊貼（paratrabecular）；右側只剩一小區殘存三系造血及散在巨核細胞，是系統性肥大細胞增生症伴纖維化的典型低倍表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow core largely replaced by a pale eosinophilic, fibrotic spindle-cell infiltrate
Infiltrate abuts and wraps around bony trabeculae (paratrabecular distribution)
Streaming spindled cells embedded in collagen-rich stroma
Small focal area of residual trilineage hematopoiesis on one side, with scattered megakaryocytes
Absence of marrow fat in the sampled area
62995.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of the bone marrow trephine shows a markedly hypercellular marrow extensively replaced by a pale, collagen-rich infiltrate of spindled cells that lies adjacent to and encases the bony trabeculae. A small focus of residual trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered megakaryocytes is present at one edge. Marrow fat is absent in this field. Megakaryocyte dysplasia cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a diffuse, fibrotic mast cell infiltrate of systemic mastocytosis, to be confirmed with tryptase, CD117 and CD25.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered bizarre megakaryocytes with streaming hematopoiesis in fibrosis, and the spindle cells are tryptase/CD117-negative.
Metastases form cohesive nests or pleomorphic sheets that are keratin- or lineage-marker-positive rather than tryptase/CD25-positive.
Marrow Hodgkin lymphoma shows fibrosis with a mixed inflammatory infiltrate and CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells.
Paratrabecular fibrosis there is accompanied by increased osteoclasts and osteoblasts, without mast cell aggregates.

62867.recognize_zh: 這是 Sanger 定序的色層圖（chromatogram），標示欄位是單一乾淨的峰，未見雙峰，代表為同型合子（homozygous）位點；圖中所示序列並未標註基因座標，需對照報告確認 SEC23B c.1385A>G 變異。
features: Sanger sequencing electropherogram with base calls above color-coded peaks
Highlighted position shows a single clean peak without an overlapping second peak (homozygous call)
Local sequence reads TTGGCATCT[A]TTTTGAAGTT around positions 70-80
Clean baseline with well-separated peaks and no background noise
Base call at the highlighted position is displayed as A (green peak), not G
62867.describe_en: This figure is a Sanger sequencing electropherogram rather than a morphologic image. The highlighted nucleotide shows a single, clean peak without a superimposed second peak, consistent with a homozygous genotype at that position, and the surrounding trace is of good quality. Note that the base call displayed at the highlighted position is A (green peak) within a TAT codon context, whereas the reported variant is SEC23B c.1385A>G (p.Tyr462Cys); the panel lacks coordinates and strand orientation, so the reported homozygous change cannot be verified from this image alone and should be confirmed against the annotated report. Biallelic SEC23B pathogenic variants cause congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II.

62739.recognize_zh: Perls 鐵染色高倍下，中央巨噬細胞的樹枝狀胞質內有粗大、深藍黑色的含鐵血黃素顆粒，而周圍被紅色複染的紅血球前驅細胞胞質內幾乎看不到藍色鐵顆粒，表示鐵囤積在巨噬細胞、未被紅血球系利用。
features: Central macrophage with dendritic cytoplasmic processes containing coarse blue-black hemosiderin globules
Iron granules of variable size, from fine dots to large round aggregates
Surrounding erythroid precursors (red nuclear counterstain) largely lacking visible cytoplasmic siderotic granules
No ring sideroblasts identified in this field
Orange-staining background red cells and plasma
62739.describe_en: Perls (Prussian blue) stain of a bone marrow aspirate at high power shows a macrophage with dendritic processes containing abundant coarse blue-black hemosiderin granules and globules. The adjacent erythroid precursors, highlighted by the red counterstain, show few or no cytoplasmic siderotic granules, and no ring sideroblasts are seen in this field. This pattern of increased macrophage storage iron with reduced sideroblastic iron indicates impaired iron utilization (reticuloendothelial iron block), as seen in anemia of chronic disease/inflammation; clinical correlation is required.

ddx.vs: Also has increased storage iron, but erythroid precursors show coarse perinuclear siderotic granules encircling at least one-third of the nucleus.
Shows absent storage iron in marrow macrophages and absent sideroblasts, the opposite of this field.
Storage iron is increased but sideroblasts are typically normal or increased rather than reduced.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and in the background as irregular crystals, whereas hemosiderin is confined within macrophage cytoplasm.

62675.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD10 染色可見大量密集、形狀不規則且互相融合的 CD10 陽性結節，結節之間為陰性的淡藍色區域；CD10 陽性證實結節由生發中心來源的 B 細胞組成。
features: Low power: numerous closely packed, irregular CD10-positive nodules with back-to-back arrangement
Nodules vary in size and some are confluent
Strong staining within nodules with small clear/unstained holes
Interfollicular areas largely CD10 negative with scattered faint positivity
Nodules occupy most of the section
62675.describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry at low power highlights numerous closely packed, irregular and focally confluent nodules composed of CD10-positive cells, separated by largely CD10-negative interfollicular zones. The staining confirms the germinal center B-cell phenotype of the nodular population replacing the node. The distribution parallels the CD20-positive nodules and is consistent with follicular lymphoma; BCL2 expression within the follicles supports neoplasia.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are also CD10 positive, but they are fewer and better spaced, with mantle zones and BCL2-negative germinal center cells.
NMZL cells are CD10 negative, with only residual colonized germinal centers staining.
MCL nodules are CD10 negative and cyclin D1 positive.

62611.recognize_zh: MUM1 染色中絕大多數腫瘤細胞呈強弱不一但彌漫的棕色核染色，只剩少數梭形基質細胞與內皮細胞核呈藍色，支持漿細胞分化的腫瘤。
features: Diffuse nuclear MUM1/IRF4 positivity in the majority of tumor cells, varying from moderate to strong
Positive cells have round eccentric nuclei with some cytoplasmic blush; occasional large atypical positive cells
Negative spindled stromal/endothelial nuclei along a fibrovascular septum (left) serve as internal negative control
Densely cellular infiltrate without architectural landmarks
62611.describe_en: MUM1 (IRF4) immunohistochemistry shows diffuse nuclear positivity in the large majority of neoplastic cells, including scattered larger atypical forms, while stromal and endothelial cells are negative. MUM1 expression indicates late B-cell/plasma cell differentiation. Combined with CD20 negativity, CD3 negativity, EBER positivity and kappa restriction, findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: ABC-DLBCL is also MUM1-positive but retains CD20/PAX5 and consists of centroblasts or immunoblasts.
Shares MUM1 and CD138 positivity with CD20 loss; separated by immunoblastic morphology and near-100% Ki-67.
Melanoma can be MUM1-positive but expresses S100/SOX10 and lacks CD138 and light-chain restriction.

62547.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中只見一顆分葉正常、顆粒適中的嗜中性球，紅血球大小稍不一，有少數較大的紅血球；此圖本身缺乏特異性，須結合血球數低下與骨髓發現才能支持 RCC。
features: Single segmented neutrophil with four nuclear lobes and normal-appearing granulation
No obvious hypogranularity or pseudo-Pelger-Huet change in this cell
Red cells with mild anisocytosis, including occasional larger (macrocytic) cells
Paucity of leukocytes and platelets in the field
62547.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single segmented neutrophil with normal lobation and granulation. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional macrocytes, without significant poikilocytosis. Leukocytes and platelets appear sparse in this field, although counts cannot be judged from a single high-power field. No blasts or dysplastic granulocytes are identified. Findings are nonspecific; macrocytosis and cytopenias may accompany refractory cytopenia of childhood but require correlation with blood counts and marrow examination.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia can show identical blood findings, and is distinguished by a hypocellular marrow without dysplasia.
Fanconi anemia also presents with macrocytosis and cytopenias and requires chromosomal breakage testing for separation.
Overt MDS with dysgranulopoiesis would show hypogranular or hypolobated neutrophils, which are absent in this cell.

62483.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下脾臟白髓明顯擴大成大型、融合傾向的紫藍色淋巴結節，結節間只剩狹窄的粉紅色紅髓，結節內未見明顯反應性生發中心，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的結節性浸潤。
features: Markedly expanded, large round-to-oval lymphoid nodules replacing white pulp
Nodules composed of densely packed small lymphoid cells without obvious reactive germinal centers at this power
Some nodules show a subtle paler outer rim, suggestive of a marginal zone component
Intervening congested eosinophilic red pulp with scattered vessels and trabeculae
62483.describe_en: H&E section of spleen at low power shows markedly expanded white pulp nodules composed of densely packed small lymphoid cells, with no obvious reactive germinal centers at this magnification. Some nodules show a subtle paler peripheral rim, suggesting a biphasic pattern with a marginal zone component. The intervening red pulp is congested and compressed. Cytologic detail requires higher magnification. Findings are consistent with a nodular low-grade B-cell lymphoma of white pulp, compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma nodules contain cleaved centrocytes and centroblasts and are CD10/BCL6 positive.
Mantle cell lymphoma nodules lack a paler marginal zone rim and are CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.
CLL/SLL involves both white and red pulp with proliferation centers and is CD5 and CD23 positive.

62419.recognize_zh: 剛果紅染色在偏光顯微鏡下，血管壁內的無定形沉積物呈現黃綠色雙折射（apple-green birefringence），而周圍的膠原則是白色光亮；這種位於血管壁的綠色雙折射就是類澱粉沉積（amyloid）的確診依據。
features: Apple-green (with yellow) birefringence of amorphous deposits under polarized light
Deposits localized to walls/lumina of medium-sized blood vessels
Surrounding collagen shows non-specific white birefringence
Adjacent adipose tissue visible as honeycomb spaces
Congo red-stained section viewed with crossed polarizers
62419.describe_en: Congo red-stained section examined under polarized light shows amorphous deposits within the walls of several medium-sized blood vessels in fibroadipose tissue. These deposits display characteristic apple-green to yellow birefringence, distinct from the white birefringence of surrounding collagen. The findings confirm vascular amyloid deposition; in a patient with plasma cell myeloma, AL amyloidosis is favored, and amyloid typing by mass spectrometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Collagen and hyaline change show white or silvery birefringence without Congo red affinity rather than apple-green birefringence.
Non-amyloid monoclonal light chain deposits are Congo red-negative and non-birefringent, with granular deposits on electron microscopy.
Morphology is identical, so the amyloid protein must be typed by mass spectrometry or immunostaining to distinguish it from AL amyloid.

62355.recognize_zh: 瀰漫性浸潤的腫瘤細胞中，只有一部分呈中度到強度膜狀 CD5 陽性，其餘細胞陰性；T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤的 CD5 表現本就不一致，部分喪失並不排除 T 系。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of closely packed cells with scant cytoplasm
Membranous CD5 staining in a subset of cells, moderate to strong, with many negative cells
Patchy and heterogeneous staining distribution across the field
Entrapped negative non-lymphoid structures (possibly vessels or residual epithelium) on the right
62355.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 shows moderate to strong membranous positivity in a subset of the infiltrating cells, with a substantial proportion negative. Entrapped CD5-negative non-hematopoietic structures are present. Partial CD5 expression is common in T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma and, when interpreted with CD3, TdT and CD1a, supports T lineage; distinction of positive tumor cells from admixed reactive T cells requires correlation with the other stains.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells are small mature CD5+ lymphocytes that are TdT-negative and CD1a-negative.
Blastoid MCL is CD5+ but B-lineage (CD20+, PAX5+), cyclin D1+ and SOX11+, and lacks CD3 and TdT.
Thymocytes in thymoma are CD5+ and TdT+ but are mixed with a cytokeratin-positive epithelial network.

62291.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構大致被抹除，副皮質區擴大，只剩少數殘存濾泡；高倍下是中等大小、核稍不規則且可見小核仁的淋巴細胞，間雜許多粉紅色細胞質的組織球與凋亡小體，符合全身性 EBV 陽性 T 細胞淋巴瘤的淋巴結表現。
features: Low power: largely effaced nodal architecture with expanded paracortex and only a few residual follicles
Intact capsule with congested vessels at the periphery
High power: medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to mildly irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Numerous admixed histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Scattered apoptotic bodies/eosinophilic apoptotic cells without prominent Reed-Sternberg-like cells
62291.describe_en: Sections of cervical lymph node show largely effaced architecture with marked paracortical expansion and only a few residual follicles beneath an intact capsule. At high power, the paracortex is infiltrated by a population of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with numerous histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and scattered apoptotic bodies. No sheets of large anaplastic cells or classic Reed-Sternberg cells are seen. In correlation with the T-cell immunophenotype and diffuse EBER positivity, findings are consistent with systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: IM shows a polymorphous paracortical immunoblastic proliferation with plasma cells and EBER-positive B immunoblasts, preserved sinuses and polyclonal T cells.
AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks and PD-1/CXCL13+ neoplastic cells, with EBER mainly in scattered B cells rather than the T cells.
PTCL-NOS can look identical but lacks EBV infection of the majority of neoplastic T cells on EBER ISH.
THRLBCL contains scattered large CD20+ B cells in a T-cell/histiocyte background, whereas here the atypical cells are T cells.

62035.recognize_zh: 紅色膜染色的大型細胞密集成片、彼此相連，不再是散在於小淋巴球之間的孤立細胞；大型陽性細胞成片生長代表 NLPHL 已進展為瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）。
features: Confluent sheets of large cells with strong membranous red chromogen staining
Large cells have oval to irregular vesicular nuclei with moderate cytoplasm
Positive cells abut one another without an intervening small-lymphocyte background
Scattered negative endothelial-lined vessels and stromal cells
Only few interspersed small negative cells
62035.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; antigen not labeled, membranous pattern consistent with a B-cell marker such as CD20) shows confluent sheets of large atypical cells with strong membranous staining. The large cells have vesicular, irregular nuclei and are closely packed, with only rare interspersed negative small cells and unstained vessels. The sheet-like growth of large positive B cells, in contrast to the scattered LP cells of typical NLPHL, is consistent with progression to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in the setting of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL has scattered large B cells comprising a minority (<10%) in a T-cell/histiocyte background, whereas this field shows confluent sheets of large B cells.
Variant NLPHL shows LP cells as individual or small clusters, not confluent sheets as seen here.
Morphology is identical; separation relies on a concurrent or prior NLPHL component in the specimen or history.

61971.recognize_zh: CD4 免疫染色中，表皮下方的真皮浸潤細胞幾乎全部呈強烈細胞膜陽性，形成緻密一片；表皮內只有少數散在的陽性細胞（可能為 Langerhans 細胞或少量 T 細胞），且表皮與浸潤間有淡染的空隙帶；CD4 陽性為主的真皮浸潤是 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病的定義表型。
features: Dense dermal infiltrate with strong membranous CD4 staining in the vast majority of lymphoid cells
Positive cells are small to medium-sized with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Relatively spared papillary dermis (grenz-like zone) beneath the epidermis
Only scattered CD4-positive cells within the epidermis (Langerhans cells or rare T cells); no epidermotropic sheets
Faint background staining of histiocytes and dendritic cells
61971.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD4 on a skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate in which the large majority of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells show strong membranous staining. The superficial papillary dermis is relatively spared, and only scattered CD4-positive cells are present within the epidermis without significant epidermotropism. The CD4-predominant phenotype, together with scarce CD8-positive cells, is consistent with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder in the appropriate clinical setting of a solitary lesion.

ddx.vs: Mycosis fungoides is also CD4-positive but shows epidermotropic atypical cells and Pautrier microabscesses with a patch/plaque history.
BPDCN cells are CD4-positive but blastic, CD3-negative and positive for CD56, CD123 and TCF4, typically sparing the epidermis with a grenz zone.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
ddx.vs: ATLL is CD4+/CD25+ with CD7 loss, pleomorphic flower-like cells and positive HTLV-1 serology.

61907.recognize_zh: 高倍下真皮血管周圍有密集的小至中型淋巴球，細胞核形不規則、染色質深，並侵入血管壁與周圍膠原間；左側可見一小段汗腺導管上皮。浸潤細胞輕中度異型、以血管為中心，符合HV-LPD的真皮浸潤。
features: Dense perivascular infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells around a dilated dermal vessel
Nuclei irregular, angulated or elongated with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Lymphocytes permeate the vessel wall and dissect between surrounding collagen bundles
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei; no sheets of large pleomorphic cells
Adjacent eccrine ductal epithelium at left without significant destruction
61907.describe_en: Sections of dermis show a dense perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, permeating the wall of a dilated vessel and dissecting between collagen bundles. Occasional larger cells are present, but sheets of large atypical cells and necrosis are not seen. An adjacent eccrine duct is intact. The mildly to moderately atypical angiocentric infiltrate, together with EBER positivity and a cytotoxic T/NK phenotype, is consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: ENKTL shows more pronounced angiodestruction with coagulative necrosis and larger pleomorphic EBER-positive cells, usually in adults and not in a photodistributed vesicular eruption.

ddx.dx: Mycosis fungoides / primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These lack EBV, and MF shows epidermotropism with cerebriform cells rather than an angiocentric dermal cytotoxic infiltrate.
Reactive infiltrates consist of small round non-atypical lymphocytes confined around vessels without vessel wall permeation and with rare or no EBER-positive cells.

61843.recognize_zh: 中倍下成片的泡沫狀（xanthomatous）組織球，細胞質淡而呈細空泡狀，夾雜交錯的纖維化膠原與小淋巴球聚集；這種「泡沫組織球加纖維化」是 Erdheim-Chester 病的典型組織像。
features: Sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm
Small, bland, round to oval nuclei without significant atypia or mitoses
Interlacing collagenous fibrosis separating histiocyte nests
Focal small lymphocytic aggregate
No emperipolesis or eosinophil-rich infiltrate evident
61843.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse infiltrate of histiocytes with abundant pale, foamy cytoplasm and small bland nuclei, arranged in nests and sheets separated by interlacing bands of collagenous fibrosis. A small lymphoid aggregate is present, and there is no significant cytologic atypia, mitotic activity, emperipolesis, or eosinophil-rich background in this field. The histiocytes would be expected to be CD68+/CD163+/factor XIIIa+ with CD1a and Langerin negativity. Findings are consistent with a xanthogranulomatous histiocytosis and, with appropriate clinical and radiologic correlation and BRAF/MAPK pathway testing, with Erdheim-Chester disease.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, reniform nuclei with eosinophilic rather than foamy cytoplasm, prominent eosinophils, and CD1a/Langerin positivity.
RDD histiocytes are large with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm showing emperipolesis and are S100 positive.
Reactive xanthogranulomatous processes contain abundant plasma cells or organisms and lack BRAF V600E or systemic long-bone osteosclerosis.

ddx.dx: Clear cell carcinoma (e.g. renal cell carcinoma)
ddx.vs: Clear cell carcinoma shows glycogen-rich clear cytoplasm, delicate vascular network, and keratin/PAX8 positivity rather than CD68/CD163.

61715.recognize_zh: 骨髓 core 切片低倍下，骨小樑間被一片密集、單調的中小型圓核細胞彌漫取代，幾乎看不到脂肪及正常造血三系，上方可見疏鬆纖維間質；此為 BPDCN 骨髓彌漫浸潤的樣式，但需高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Markedly hypercellular intertrabecular space with near-total loss of fat
Diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small-to-intermediate cells with round dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Loss of normal trilineage hematopoiesis; megakaryocytes not identifiable at this power
Loose fibrous/edematous stroma with spindle cells at the upper portion of the field
Intact lamellar bony trabeculae without osteolysis
61715.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, low power) shows a markedly hypercellular marrow space with near-total effacement of fat by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small-to-intermediate cells with round hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not appreciated at this magnification, and an area of loose fibrous stroma is present at the upper aspect. The adjacent bony trabeculae are intact. The findings indicate extensive marrow replacement by a blastic or lymphoid neoplasm, compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in conjunction with immunohistochemistry (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4).

ddx.vs: AML may show identical diffuse replacement at low power, and separation requires MPO/CD34/CD117 versus CD123/TCF4/CD56 immunostains.
Lymphoblasts form similar sheets but are TdT-positive with B- or T-lineage markers and CD123/CD56-negative.

ddx.dx: Small B-cell lymphoma (e.g., mantle cell or small lymphocytic)
ddx.vs: Mature lymphoma cells have coarser chromatin and often nodular/paratrabecular patterns, and express CD20 with cyclin D1 or CD5/CD23.

61587.recognize_zh: 右側肝臟竇狀隙內有許多 CD14 陽性的單核球/巨噬細胞沿竇壁分布，左側較密的浸潤區則多為弱陽性或陰性；顯示 JMML 浸潤中含單核球系成分，但要注意庫佛氏細胞（Kupffer cells）本身也表現 CD14。
features: Hepatocyte plates with sinusoids containing CD14-positive cells (membranous/cytoplasmic staining)
CD14-positive cells outline and fill sinusoids on the right side of the field
Denser cellular infiltrate on the left (portal/periportal area) is largely CD14-negative or weak
Hepatocytes are negative
Kupffer cells normally express CD14, limiting quantification of neoplastic monocytes
61587.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD14 on a liver section shows numerous CD14-positive cells within the sinusoids, outlining the hepatocyte plates on the right side of the field. A denser mononuclear infiltrate on the left, likely periportal, is largely negative to weakly positive, indicating a mixed population. Hepatocytes are negative. Because resident Kupffer cells also express CD14, the stain supports a monocytic component within the sinusoidal infiltrate but does not by itself quantify neoplastic monocytes; in context, findings are consistent with hepatic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: CD14+ sinusoidal lining cells are present but not accompanied by a dense immature myelomonocytic and erythroid infiltrate.
Shows sheets of monoblasts/promonocytes with a high blast count rather than a mixed maturing infiltrate with rare CD34+ cells.
CD68/CD163+ histiocytes show hemophagocytosis, lacking a myeloproliferative background.

61523.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結節周圍被寬厚的膠原纖維帶包圍，結節內散布許多 lacunar 細胞：大型細胞的淡染胞質因固定收縮而在核周形成透明空隙，背景是小淋巴球，符合結節硬化型 CHL（NSCHL）。
features: Broad band of dense, birefringent-appearing collagen encircling a cellular nodule (upper right)
Numerous lacunar cells with clear retracted cytoplasm leaving empty spaces around lobated nuclei
Lacunar cells concentrated toward the nodule periphery and scattered throughout
Background of small lymphocytes with some histiocytes; fibrous strands extending into the nodule
61523.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows a cellular nodule demarcated by a broad band of dense collagen with fibrous strands extending into the lymphoid tissue. Within the nodule, numerous lacunar variants of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are present, characterized by large, lobated nuclei with small nucleoli surrounded by clear retracted cytoplasm, in a background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes. No sheets of large cells or necrosis are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.

ddx.vs: Mixed cellularity lacks broad collagen bands forming nodules and has classic RS cells rather than numerous lacunar cells in a diffuse mixed background.
PMBL shows sheets of large cells with clear cytoplasm compartmentalized by fine delicate fibrosis, and the cells are strongly CD20/PAX5+ and CD15−.
ALCL has cohesive sheets and sinusoidal clusters of hallmark cells with kidney-shaped nuclei that are PAX5-negative and ALK or T-cell marker positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma with sclerosis
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor forms cohesive clusters that are keratin- or SOX10/S100-positive rather than CD30+/CD15+ lacunar cells.

61459.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中多顆中大型漿細胞：胞質深藍、核偏位、染色質較細並可見核仁，部分為雙核；背景紅血球排成錢串狀（rouleaux），合看支持多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Numerous medium-to-large plasma cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Some plasma cells show a relatively high N:C ratio, finer chromatin, and visible nucleoli (immature features)
Perinuclear hof inconspicuous in several cells; occasional binucleate/cohesive pair
Background red cells form short stacks (rouleaux)
Scattered small lymphocytes and a neutrophil; no normal hematopoietic particle in field
61459.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells, many medium to large, with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, and relatively fine chromatin with discernible nucleoli, including binucleate forms. The background red cells show prominent rouleaux formation, reflecting increased serum paraprotein. Normal hematopoietic precursors are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; a plasma cell percentage on a 500-cell differential and flow cytometry for clonality are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small and mature with clumped clock-face chromatin, lack nucleoli, and are polytypic.
Cells are larger with prominent nucleoli, dispersed chromatin and scant hof, with high proliferation index.
Contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P rather than predominance of atypical plasma cells.
Proerythroblasts have round central nuclei, darker blue cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs, and no perinuclear hof.

61395.recognize_zh: CD3 免疫染色中，大量背景小淋巴球呈細胞膜與細胞質棕色陽性，而中央及右上方的大型淡染核巨細胞完全不著色（陰性），表示大細胞不是 T 細胞，而是散佈在反應性 T 細胞背景中的 B 細胞。
features: Numerous small background lymphocytes with membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD3 staining
Large giant cells with pale vesicular, lobated nuclei are CD3-negative (center and upper right)
Histiocytes and stromal cells with oval nuclei negative
No rosetting pattern clearly evident around the large cells in this field
61395.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry highlights a rich background of small T lymphocytes with membranous and cytoplasmic staining. The large atypical giant cells, recognizable by their large pale lobated nuclei, are negative, as are histiocytes and stromal cells. The findings indicate that the large atypical cells are not of T-cell lineage and lie within a reactive T-cell-rich background; together with B-cell marker expression and EBER positivity, this supports EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer.

ddx.vs: Atypical medium-to-large cells are themselves CD3-positive, often with aberrant loss of CD5 or CD7, rather than CD3-negative large cells in a small T-cell background.
Also shows CD3-negative HRS cells with a T-cell background often forming rosettes, so separation relies on CD20, CD15 and clinical site rather than CD3.
Shares CD3-negative large B cells in a T-cell background, but typically EBER-negative with nodal or systemic disease.

61267.recognize_zh: 箭頭附近一群大型細胞共享大片淡藍、帶細顆粒的細胞質，每個細胞只有一個橢圓形偏心核，核常被推到細胞邊緣，部分細胞質中可見遠離核的淡染區（Golgi zone）；底部還有粉紅色的骨基質碎片，符合骨髓抹片中的造骨細胞（osteoblast）群。
features: Loose sheet of large cells with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and poorly defined borders
Single oval to round eccentric nuclei with evenly dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli; nuclei often displaced to the cell edge
Pale cytoplasmic clearing (Golgi zone) located away from the nucleus in some cells
Pink fibrillar material at the bottom of the field, likely bone matrix/stromal fragment
Background red cells; eyepiece photograph with bluish cast and moderate focus
61267.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a loose aggregate of large mononuclear cells with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and single eccentric oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Some cells show a pale Golgi zone separated from the nucleus. Pink fibrillar material consistent with a bony or stromal fragment is present at the edge of the field. There is no nuclear pleomorphism, molding or mitotic activity. Findings are consistent with osteoblasts, a benign constituent of marrow aspirates.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are smaller with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof directly adjacent to a clock-face nucleus rather than a Golgi zone away from the nucleus.
An osteoclast contains multiple uniform nuclei within one continuous cytoplasm, whereas here each nucleus belongs to a separate cell.
Carcinoma clusters show pleomorphic, overlapping, often molded nuclei with prominent nucleoli and high N:C ratios.
Histiocytes have folded or bean-shaped nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm with ingested debris.

61203.recognize_zh: 血液抹片右下方一顆比紅血球還大的巨大血小板，內含粗大紫紅色顆粒，與中央正常大小的小血小板對比明顯；左上中性球顆粒正常、無 Döhle 樣包涵體，符合 Bernard-Soulier 症候群的巨血小板。
features: Giant platelet at lower right, larger than neighboring red cells, with coarse purple granules and a pale hyalomere
Normal-sized platelet in the center for comparison
Band neutrophil at upper left with normal granulation and no Döhle-like inclusions
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with central pallor
No platelet clumps or satellitism
61203.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a giant platelet exceeding the diameter of the adjacent red cells, containing coarse purple granules, alongside a normal-sized platelet that highlights the size discrepancy. The neutrophil present has normal granulation without Döhle-like inclusions, and red cells are unremarkable. There is no platelet clumping to suggest pseudothrombocytopenia. Findings are consistent with inherited macrothrombocytopenia such as Bernard-Soulier syndrome, to be confirmed by absent ristocetin agglutination and GPIb-IX-V deficiency on flow cytometry or genetic testing (GP1BA, GP1BB, GP9).

ddx.vs: Neutrophils contain blue Döhle-like inclusions and ristocetin response is normal.
Large young platelets are seen but platelet size is more heterogeneous, function testing is normal and thrombocytopenia is acquired.

ddx.dx: Lymphocyte or small red cell misidentification
ddx.vs: A giant platelet lacks a nucleus and hemoglobinized cytoplasm, showing granular purple content with a pale hyalomere.

61139.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血中的中性球細胞質內可見金黃色、具折光性的結晶：A 為數顆菱形／顆粒狀，B 為成束放射狀的針狀結晶，顏色與膽紅素結晶一致，其他白血球與背景紅血球則無此包涵體。
features: Neutrophils containing golden-yellow to orange-brown, refractile intracytoplasmic crystals
Panel A: several small rhomboid/globular crystals scattered among the nuclear lobes
Panel B: sheaf of radiating needle-shaped crystals overlying the neutrophil
Neutrophil nuclei and granules otherwise unremarkable; adjacent lymphocytes lack inclusions
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis, including macrocytes typical of neonatal blood; occasional platelets
61139.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a neonate shows neutrophils containing golden-yellow, refractile intracytoplasmic crystals, appearing as small rhomboid granules in one cell and as a sheaf of radiating needles in another. The crystals are non-staining with Wright-Giemsa and retain their intrinsic yellow color, while adjacent lymphocytes and red cells are free of inclusions. Background red cells show neonatal macrocytosis. Findings are consistent with bilirubin crystal inclusions in neutrophils, typically seen in markedly hyperbilirubinemic neonates or as an in vitro artifact of a delayed icteric sample.

ddx.dx: Hemosiderin or malarial pigment in phagocytes
ddx.vs: Hemozoin is brown-black granular and hemosiderin is dark blue-green to brown granular, not bright golden needle-shaped refractile crystals.
Cryoglobulin inclusions are pale blue-gray amorphous or crystalline material that does not have a yellow color.
Stain precipitate is dark purple, lies on top of cells and background alike, and is not confined to neutrophil cytoplasm.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are pale, bipyramidal and associated with eosinophils, not golden needles within neutrophils.

61075.recognize_zh: 多個未變大的紅血球內含細小的環狀滋養體（藍色細胞質環加紅紫色染色質點），其中一個貼附在紅血球邊緣呈貼邊型（accolé/appliqué form），部分細胞含兩個環狀體，符合惡性瘧原蟲感染。
features: Several normal-sized red cells containing small, delicate ring-form trophozoites with thin blue cytoplasm and red-purple chromatin dots
Some ring forms show double chromatin dots or two parasites per cell
Parasite applied to the red cell margin (accolé/appliqué form) near the bottom of the field
No enlargement of infected cells, Schuffner stippling, pigment, schizonts or gametocytes in this field
Background red cells otherwise unremarkable; low parasitemia estimate not possible from a single field
61075.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows several non-enlarged red cells containing small, delicate ring-form trophozoites, including forms with double chromatin dots, a red cell with more than one parasite, and a peripherally applied (accolé) form. Infected cells lack stippling, and no mature trophozoites, schizonts or crescent-shaped gametocytes are seen in this field. In a traveler returning from Africa with cyclic fever, findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified on the thin film.

ddx.vs: Babesia shows pleomorphic intraerythrocytic rings, occasionally extracellular forms and tetrads, without accolé forms or pigment, and occurs after tick exposure.
Vivax and ovale parasitize enlarged, Schuffner-stippled red cells and show amoeboid or compact trophozoites rather than fine accolé rings.
P. malariae infects normal-sized cells but shows thicker rings, band-form trophozoites and rosette schizonts with low parasitemia.

ddx.dx: Platelet or stain precipitate overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets and precipitate lack the ring-shaped cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot and lie in a different focal plane.

61011.recognize_zh: 血清蛋白電泳在 gamma 區出現一個高而窄的尖峰（M-spike），gamma 分率 57.2%（5.1 g/dL），白蛋白降低、A/G 比 0.32，提示單株免疫球蛋白病（如多發性骨髓瘤）。
features: Serum protein electrophoresis densitometry tracing with a tall, narrow, sharply defined peak in the gamma region (peak 2)
Gamma fraction markedly increased at 57.2% (5.1 g/dL; reference 8.0-15.8%)
Albumin decreased to 24.2% (2.2 g/dL) with inverted A/G ratio of 0.32
Beta fraction mildly decreased (6.4%); a smaller shaded peak (peak 1) in the beta region
Total protein elevated at 8.9 g/dL
61011.describe_en: Serum protein electrophoresis shows a discrete, narrow, homogeneous band in the gamma region quantified at approximately 5.1 g/dL (57.2% of total protein), with hypoalbuminemia (2.2 g/dL), total protein 8.9 g/dL, and an A/G ratio of 0.32. A smaller shaded peak is also marked in the beta region. The narrow gamma peak indicates a monoclonal gammopathy rather than polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia; immunofixation is required to type the paraprotein. In a patient with back pain and anemia, findings are suggestive of plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Polyclonal increase produces a broad-based diffuse gamma elevation rather than a narrow spike, and immunofixation shows no restricted band.
MGUS has an M-protein <3 g/dL, <10% marrow plasma cells and no CRAB features, whereas this spike exceeds 5 g/dL in a symptomatic patient.
Immunofixation showing IgM with lymphoplasmacytic marrow infiltrate and MYD88 L265P separates it from IgG/IgA myeloma.

60947.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型細胞核質比高、染色質細緻分散且有核仁，外觀像芽細胞，但細胞核仍略偏位並有一圈深藍細胞質；切片 CD34 陰性（僅血管內皮陽性）、CD138 強陽性，確認是具漿母細胞形態的漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Large mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio, fine dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli (blast-like)
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, nucleus central to slightly eccentric, no obvious perinuclear hof
Admixed smaller, more mature plasmacytoid cells and residual erythroid precursors
Biopsy H&E: diffuse sheets of monotonous cells with round nuclei
IHC: CD34 negative in neoplastic cells (only endothelium stains); CD138 strong membranous positivity in sheets
60947.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows diffuse infiltration by large blast-like mononuclear cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, nucleoli and a thin rim of deep basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with smaller plasmacytoid cells. The trephine biopsy shows sheets of monotonous cells effacing normal hematopoiesis. The infiltrate is negative for CD34, which highlights only endothelial cells, and strongly positive for CD138. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology, which should not be mistaken for acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML blasts are MPO/CD33/CD34 or CD117 positive and CD138 negative without a monoclonal paraprotein, whereas these cells are CD138+ with cytoplasmic kappa and CD34-negative.
Usually extranodal in immunodeficient patients, EBER-positive and often MYC-rearranged, without the marrow-based IgG paraprotein picture of myeloma.
DLBCL cells express CD20/PAX5 and lack CD138/cytoplasmic light-chain predominance.
Defined by circulating clonal plasma cells (≥5% in PB, WHO 2022), which must be assessed on the blood smear rather than marrow morphology.

60883.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的纖維化間質中，可見大型、深染、核質比高的腫瘤細胞成巢並沿纖維隔排列，形態上與周圍造血細胞不同、具黏聚性，提示非造血性的轉移性小圓藍細胞腫瘤（此例為肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Nests and cords of medium-to-large tumor cells with high N:C ratio set in pink fibrotic stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula
Hyperchromatic round to oval, sometimes molded or elongated nuclei with coarse chromatin
Scant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm; cells cohesive with focal discohesion within spaces vaguely resembling alveolar spaces
Spindled fibroblast-like cells and collagen forming septa between tumor islands
Scattered red cells; residual normal hematopoiesis not evident in this field
60883.describe_en: High-power view of a hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows a fibrotic stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula replaced by islands and cords of cohesive, medium-to-large tumor cells. The cells have hyperchromatic round to oval nuclei with coarse chromatin and scant amphophilic cytoplasm, and are separated by collagenous septa with focal loss of cohesion in the center of nests.
