Normal hematopoietic elements are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic small round blue cell tumor; immunohistochemistry (desmin, myogenin) supports metastatic alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma may form rosettes with neuropil and is synaptophysin/PHOX2B positive and myogenin negative.
Ewing cells are more uniform with fine chromatin and clear glycogen-rich cytoplasm, and are CD99/NKX2.2 positive and myogenin negative.
Lymphoblasts are discohesive and diffusely infiltrative rather than nested in fibrous septa, and express TdT with lineage markers.
Megakaryoblasts in fibrotic marrow can cluster, but express CD61/CD42b and are negative for desmin and myogenin.

60819.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片呈顆粒球系各階段增生（骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀與分節球）並有嗜鹼性球，B 圖見小型、低分葉的異常巨核細胞；核型與 FISH 顯示 BCR::ABL1 融合位於衍生的 12 號染色體上，屬於複雜染色體重排的慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）。
features: Hypercellular aspirate particles with granulocytic hyperplasia showing a full maturation spectrum (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils)
Basophils with dark purple granules and occasional eosinophils
Dysplastic megakaryocyte with a small hypolobated/monolobated nucleus and abundant blue cytoplasm (panel B)
No obvious increase in blasts in the fields shown
Karyotype (panel C) with arrows marking abnormal chromosomes; metaphase FISH (panel D) with BCR (green) and ABL1 (red) probes showing BCR::ABL1 fusion on a der(12)
60819.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show hypercellular particles with marked granulocytic hyperplasia and orderly maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils, with increased basophils. Megakaryocytes include small hypolobated dysplastic forms with abundant cytoplasm. Blasts are not increased in the fields shown. The karyotype shows rearranged chromosomes (arrows), and sequential G-banding to FISH localizes the BCR::ABL1 fusion signal to a derivative chromosome 12, indicating a complex/variant Philadelphia translocation. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, with complex chromosomal rearrangement and dysplastic megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Atypical chronic myeloid leukemia (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia)
ddx.vs: aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia without basophilia and, by definition, lacks BCR::ABL1.
CNL has mature neutrophil predominance with few immature granulocytes and no basophilia, with CSF3R mutation and no BCR::ABL1.
Reactive neutrophilia has toxic granulation, no basophilia or dwarf megakaryocytes, and no clonal cytogenetic abnormality.
MDS shows cytopenias and multilineage dysplasia with hypogranular neutrophils rather than marked left-shifted granulocytic proliferation with BCR::ABL1.

captions: A: hypercellular aspirate with granulocytic hyperplasia; B: dysplastic hypolobated megakaryocyte among maturing granulocytes and basophils; C: karyotype with abnormal chromosomes marked (arrows); D: sequential G-banding and FISH showing BCR::ABL1 fusion on der(12)

60691.recognize_zh: 組圖解析度很低：A 為大量紅血球的血性心包膜液，B、C 細胞離心抹片可見中至大型、核染色深且胞質嗜鹼性的非典型淋巴樣細胞，D、E 心臟超音波顯示心包膜積液；結合臨床，指向以心包填塞表現的母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: grossly/microscopically hemorrhagic fluid dominated by red cells
Panels B-C: cytospin of pericardial fluid with discohesive medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with dark nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered cells appear blast-like, but chromatin and nucleoli cannot be assessed at this resolution
Panels D-E: echocardiographic views showing a pericardial effusion surrounding the heart
60691.describe_en: Composite figure shows a hemorrhagic pericardial fluid (A) whose cytocentrifuge preparations (B, C) contain numerous discohesive medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with dark nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with red cells. Echocardiographic images (D, E) demonstrate a pericardial effusion. The low image resolution precludes detailed assessment of chromatin and nucleoli, and the blastoid mantle cell phenotype requires cyclin D1/SOX11 immunostaining or t(11;14) confirmation. Findings are compatible with pericardial involvement by blastoid mantle cell lymphoma presenting as cardiac tamponade.

ddx.vs: Cells are immunoblastic/plasmablastic, HHV-8 positive and usually lack B-cell markers and cyclin D1.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving pericardium
ddx.vs: Can look identical cytologically; it is cyclin D1 negative and lacks t(11;14).
Cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters and are cytokeratin positive, CD45 negative.
Blasts are TdT/CD34 or MPO positive, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT negative with CD5/cyclin D1 expression.

60755.recognize_zh: 周邊血中的嗜中性球及其前驅細胞細胞質內可見少數不規則、異常巨大的紫紅色或深色顆粒（giant granules），與一般細小的嗜中性顆粒明顯不同，這是 Chédiak-Higashi 症候群的關鍵形態特徵。
features: Neutrophils and granulocytic precursors containing coarse, irregular, abnormally large azurophilic to dark purple cytoplasmic granules (giant inclusions)
Segmented neutrophil (lower left) with several large irregular pink-purple granules adjacent to the lobulated nucleus
Myelocyte/metamyelocyte-like cells with indented nuclei and scattered coarse dark granules in pale cytoplasm
Normal fine specific granulation is sparse in affected cells
Background red cells without notable abnormalities; smear is thick with overlapping red cells
60755.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of granulocytes, including a segmented neutrophil and several less mature forms with indented nuclei, whose cytoplasm contains abnormally large, irregular azurophilic to dark purple granules distinct from normal fine neutrophilic granulation. Red cells show no specific abnormality. Lymphocytes are not present in this field to assess for giant granules in lymphoid cells. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chédiak-Higashi syndrome (LYST mutation) in the appropriate clinical setting of oculocutaneous albinism and recurrent infections.

ddx.vs: Shows diffuse, fine to coarse dark granules evenly throughout the cytoplasm, often with Döhle bodies and vacuoles, rather than few discrete giant irregular inclusions.
Features dense dark azurophilic granules evenly distributed in all leukocytes in mucopolysaccharidoses, not scattered giant fused granules.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules in AML or MDS
ddx.vs: Similar giant granules occur in neoplastic myeloid cells with increased blasts or dysplasia, in adults without albinism or LYST mutation.
Has pale blue spindle-shaped Döhle-like inclusions with giant platelets and thrombocytopenia, rather than purple giant granules.

60627.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中細胞外散在多個大小不一的細長「香腸狀」小酵母，有些中間可見橫向隔膜（transverse septum，二分裂），是馬爾尼菲籃狀菌（Talaromyces/Penicillium marneffei）與組織漿菌的關鍵區別。
features: Cluster of small extracellular yeast-like organisms adjacent to a macrophage, variably round, oval and elongated (sausage-shaped)
Some elongated forms show a central transverse septum indicating division by fission rather than budding
Organisms stain purple-magenta with a thin pale outline
Background marrow with myeloid precursors, a monocytoid cell and red cells
Image resolution limits assessment of intracellular organisms
60627.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of small, extracellular yeast-like organisms adjacent to a histiocyte, varying from oval to elongated sausage-shaped forms, several of which display a central transverse septum. No budding forms are apparent. The background contains maturing myeloid cells and erythrocytes. Morphology is consistent with disseminated talaromycosis (Talaromyces [Penicillium] marneffei) and should be confirmed by fungal culture, which shows a diffusible red pigment at 25°C, or by molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are uniform oval forms with a clear halo that reproduce by narrow-based budding and lack elongated forms with a transverse septum.
Leishmania shows a nucleus plus a rod-like kinetoplast and no transverse septum.
Candida forms budding yeasts with pseudohyphae rather than septate sausage-shaped fission forms.
Bacteria are much smaller and uniform, and platelets are granular without a cell wall or septum.

60435.recognize_zh: 肝臟粗針切片中，中型不典型淋巴球沿著肝竇（sinusoids）呈線狀、網狀浸潤，把肝細胞板撐開，而非主要形成門脈區結節；免疫染色顯示 CD3 陽性細胞稀少、而另一 T 細胞標記呈強烈竇狀網狀分布，符合肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤（hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma）的竇內浸潤模式。
features: Liver needle core with a diffuse sinusoidal infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells outlining and separating hepatocyte plates (A-C)
Medium-sized cells with irregular nuclear contours, condensed/coarse chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm (C, high power)
A denser cellular aggregate at one end of the core (A, E right), with mild macrovesicular steatosis in hepatocytes
IHC panels: one T-cell marker stains only scattered cells (D), while another shows strong diffuse sinusoidal lattice-like positivity (E) and membranous staining of the infiltrate at high power (F)
No granulomas or significant portal-based destructive infiltrate
60435.describe_en: Liver needle core biopsy shows a diffuse intrasinusoidal infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells that distends the sinusoids and separates hepatocyte cords, with a denser cellular focus at one end and mild macrovesicular steatosis. At high power, the cells are medium-sized with irregular nuclear contours, coarse chromatin and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry shows that only scattered cells are positive for one T-cell marker, whereas other stains highlight the infiltrate in a sinusoidal lattice pattern and with membranous positivity at high power. Note that the panel letters in the source legend (C = CD3, D = CD8, E = TCR gamma) appear offset from the image, where panel C is H&E; the stains most likely correspond to D = CD3 (largely negative), E = CD8 and F = TCR gamma. The sinusoidal pattern with this T-cell phenotype is consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: T-LGL also infiltrates sinusoids, but cells are small mature lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm and azurophilic granules, usually CD3+CD8+ alpha-beta TCR with CD57+, not medium-sized atypical CD3-dim/negative gamma-delta cells.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive, EBER-positive and lacks TCR expression, whereas HSTCL is EBV-negative with TCR gamma-delta (or alpha-beta) expression.
Viral hepatitis shows a polymorphous, small-lymphocyte sinusoidal infiltrate with hepatocyte injury and preserved CD3 expression, not a monotonous atypical population with antigen loss.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic involvement by B-cell lymphoma (e.g., splenic marginal zone lymphoma)
ddx.vs: B-cell lymphomas show CD20-positive cells, and SMZL typically forms portal/nodular aggregates with less exclusive sinusoidal spread.

60435.stain: H&E; IHC: CD3, CD8, TCR gamma

60371.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中可見兩顆循環芽細胞，體積約為紅血球的 1.5–2 倍，核質比極高、染色質細緻、幾乎看不到細胞質，背景紅血球有標靶細胞與形狀不規則細胞，符合復發 B-ALL 的周邊血芽細胞。
features: Two circulating blasts, approximately 1.5-2 times the diameter of an RBC
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Red cells with scattered target cells, occasional teardrop and irregular poikilocytes; no platelets evident in the field
60371.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a scant rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. The red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with scattered target cells and occasional teardrop forms, and platelets are not evident in this field. Lineage cannot be assigned by morphology alone, but in the clinical context of CD34+ B-ALL, findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts from relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may contain granules or Auer rods and more cytoplasm, but agranular forms require flow cytometry to exclude myeloid lineage.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent RBCs and coarser chromatin, unlike the fine blastic chromatin here.
CLL cells are small with clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin, not the fine open chromatin of blasts.

60115.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被中到大型芽細胞鋪滿，核圓到卵圓、部分有凹陷或扭曲，染色質細緻、細胞質少且淡藍、無顆粒，正常造血細胞只剩零星嗜酸性球；型態像淋巴母細胞，需免疫表型確認 T 系。
features: Sheets of medium to large blasts replacing normal marrow elements
High N:C ratio with round to oval nuclei, some indented or convoluted
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Rare residual eosinophil and small mature lymphocytes; scattered fat vacuoles
60115.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-total replacement by sheets of medium to large blasts, with only rare residual eosinophils and small lymphocytes. The blasts have a high N:C ratio, round to oval nuclei with occasional indentation or convolution, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. Morphology is consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry supports T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: B- and T-lymphoblasts are morphologically indistinguishable; CD19/CD79a versus cytoplasmic CD3 by flow cytometry separates them.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts may look identical but are MPO-negative on cytochemistry and express CD13/CD33/CD117 without cCD3.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and a mature B phenotype (sIg+, TdT-), unlike these pale agranular blasts.

60051.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片整個視野只看到一顆小淋巴球，幾乎找不到血小板，紅血球大小形態大致正常且無碎片或多染性，提示白血球與血小板低下的全血球減少（pancytopenia）。
features: Only a single small mature lymphocyte in an entire low-power field (marked leukopenia)
Platelets are scarce to absent at this magnification
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with no obvious schistocytes, spherocytes, or polychromasia
No circulating blasts, nucleated red cells, or immature granulocytes in the field
Low magnification limits assessment of fine red cell and platelet morphology
60051.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a markedly reduced number of leukocytes, with a single small mature lymphocyte in the field and no neutrophils identified. Platelets appear markedly decreased. Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic without conspicuous schistocytes, spherocytes, or polychromasia, and no blasts or leukoerythroblastic features are seen. Findings are consistent with pancytopenia; in this clinical setting they are compatible with aplastic anemia, and the absence of a reticulocyte response should be confirmed by reticulocyte count.

ddx.vs: Florid hemolytic PNH shows polychromasia and reticulocytosis with elevated LDH, whereas this smear lacks polychromasia and instead shows a bone marrow failure picture; flow cytometry for GPI-anchored proteins distinguishes the clone size.
MDS typically shows dysplastic neutrophils (hypogranulation, pseudo-Pelger), macrocytosis, or circulating blasts, which cannot be demonstrated in this nearly acellular field.
Leukemia usually shows at least occasional circulating blasts, and marrow examination reveals increased blasts rather than fatty aplasia.
Megaloblastic pancytopenia shows oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, not the normocytic red cells seen here.

30483.recognize_zh: 眼球全切片可見脈絡膜腫瘤（A），高倍為上皮樣腫瘤細胞（B）；PET-CT 顯示全脊椎與骨盆瀰漫性攝取（C）；骨髓抹片中出現大型、核仁明顯的非造血腫瘤細胞群，細胞質含細小深色顆粒（D、E，箭頭），符合葡萄膜黑色素瘤（uveal melanoma）瀰漫侵犯骨髓。
features: Panel A: enucleated globe with a choroidal/ciliary body mass (boxed area)
Panel B: sheets of epithelioid tumor cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate clear to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Panel C: PET-CT with diffuse, intense FDG uptake throughout the axial skeleton and pelvis
Panel D: large single tumor cell with round eccentric nucleus and abundant pale cytoplasm containing fine granules (arrow)
Panel E: cohesive clump of large tumor cells with round nuclei, prominent nucleoli and fine dark cytoplasmic pigment granules, much larger than surrounding myeloid cells
30483.describe_en: Composite figure. The enucleated globe (A, H&E) contains a choroidal mass composed of epithelioid tumor cells with prominent nucleoli (B), and PET-CT (C) shows diffuse skeletal FDG avidity involving the spine and pelvis. The bone marrow aspirate (D, E, Wright-Giemsa) contains large non-hematopoietic cells, singly and in a cohesive clump, with round nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant cytoplasm with fine dark pigment-like granules (arrows), clearly larger than the background myeloid precursors. Findings are consistent with diffuse bone marrow involvement by metastatic uveal melanoma, which can be confirmed with Fontana-Masson or immunohistochemistry for SOX10, Melan-A and HMB-45.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clumps lack melanin pigment and are cytokeratin-positive and SOX10/Melan-A-negative.
Macrophages have small bland nuclei and coarse blue-black iron granules that are Prussian blue positive, rather than large nuclei with prominent nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are discohesive, lack pigment, and express CD45 with CD30/ALK or B-cell markers.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei with granular pink cytoplasm and osteoblasts show a perinuclear hof in a single-file arrangement, both without melanin.

28819.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片背景散布大量大小不一、淡藍色無核的小圓形胞質碎片，即淋巴腺小體（lymphoglandular bodies），旁邊有核大、染色質細緻、胞質嗜鹼的大型淋巴瘤細胞，提示骨髓被侵襲性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤浸潤。
features: Numerous anucleate, round, pale-to-medium blue cytoplasmic fragments of variable size (lymphoglandular bodies) scattered throughout the background
Large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with vacuoles, clustered along the lower field
Occasional macrophage with vacuolated cytoplasm containing debris
Residual normal elements including a neutrophil and granulocytic precursors with azurophilic/eosinophilic granules
28819.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a background studded with numerous small, anucleate, pale blue cytoplasmic fragments consistent with lymphoglandular bodies. There are aggregates of large atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli and deeply basophilic, occasionally vacuolated cytoplasm, together with a vacuolated macrophage and scattered residual granulocytic cells. Lymphoglandular bodies are a clue to a fragile lymphoid neoplasm rather than an epithelial process, and in this context the findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by an aggressive large B-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and biopsy immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Platelets are smaller and contain purple azurophilic granules, whereas lymphoglandular bodies are agranular pale blue cytoplasmic globules.
Blasts are typically less fragile without abundant lymphoglandular bodies and are defined by CD34/TdT/MPO rather than mature B-cell markers with surface light chain.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor or carcinoma
ddx.vs: Non-hematolymphoid tumors form cohesive clusters and lack lymphoglandular bodies, and are CD45-negative.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and near-100% Ki-67 with MYC rearrangement.

24787.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（H&E）中造血組織與脂肪之間散布多個由上皮樣組織球與多核巨細胞組成、境界清楚的肉芽腫（箭頭），看不到明顯乾酪樣壞死；IHC 染色把巨細胞與組織球整個標出來，搭配膀胱內 BCG 灌注病史即指向 BCG 感染引起的骨髓肉芽腫。
features: Multiple discrete, well-formed granulomas within cellular marrow (arrows)
Aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Multinucleated giant cells within the granulomas
No obvious caseous necrosis in the visible fields
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with interspersed fat
IHC (histiocytic marker, likely CD68) strongly highlights a multinucleated giant cell and surrounding histiocytes
24787.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy sections show a cellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis in which several discrete, well-formed granulomas are present. The granulomas are composed of epithelioid histiocytes with admixed multinucleated giant cells; caseous necrosis is not evident in the illustrated fields. Immunohistochemistry for a histiocytic marker strongly highlights the giant cells and epithelioid histiocytes. Acid-fast organisms are not identifiable at this magnification, so special stains and culture are required. In the setting of recent intravesical BCG therapy, findings are consistent with disseminated BCG infection (BCGitis) with marrow granulomatous inflammation.

ddx.dx: Tuberculosis (M. tuberculosis) or other mycobacterial infection
ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable granulomas; separation requires culture or PCR speciation (M. bovis BCG) together with the BCG exposure history.
Fungal granulomas usually contain small intracellular yeasts visible on GMS/PAS, which are absent here.
Sarcoid granulomas are similar non-necrotizing epithelioid granulomas but show negative AFB/fungal stains and cultures and no infectious exposure.
Hodgkin or T-cell lymphoma with granulomas shows an atypical lymphoid infiltrate (e.g. Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells) not seen in these fields.

19923.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中有多顆中等大小（約為紅血球兩倍）的淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質中度凝集，且每顆都有一個清楚的中央單一大核仁，細胞質中等量、淡藍色，這是典型的前淋巴球（prolymphocyte）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, roughly twice the diameter of a red cell
Moderate N:C ratio with a rim of moderate pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei, occasionally with a shallow cleft or indentation
Moderately condensed chromatin that is more mature than a blast
Single prominent central vesicular nucleolus in most cells
Background red cells unremarkable; one neutrophil and a platelet present
19923.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round, occasionally indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, a single prominent central nucleolus, and a moderate amount of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm. The chromatin is more condensed than that of blasts, and no cytoplasmic granules, hairy projections, or vacuoles are seen. Red cells and the occasional neutrophil appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with prolymphocytes; if they constitute more than 55% of circulating lymphoid cells, the differential includes B-prolymphocytic leukemia (now largely reclassified as splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli or leukemic mantle cell lymphoma) and T-prolymphocytic leukemia, requiring flow cytometry and cyclin D1/t(11;14) studies.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma, prolymphocytoid variant
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical, so cyclin D1 expression, SOX11, and t(11;14) are required to exclude MCL before accepting a prolymphocytic neoplasm.
T-PLL cells are often smaller with cytoplasmic blebs and less conspicuous nucleoli, and express CD3/CD7 with TCL1A rearrangement.
CLL has a dominant background of small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and smudge cells, with prolymphocytes under 55%, and a CD5+/CD23+/CD200+ dim sIg phenotype.
Blasts have finer, more dispersed chromatin, higher N:C ratio, less cytoplasm, and are TdT/CD34 positive.

18195.recognize_zh: 右圖周邊血可見大型芽細胞，核圓、胞質深藍且邊緣有藍色小球狀突起（箭頭），旁有小型 CLL 淋巴球；插圖 PAS 染色呈粗顆粒陽性，支持紅血球系芽細胞（erythroid blasts）。左圖組織切片可見大型芽細胞片狀浸潤與小淋巴球區並存。
features: PB: large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and intensely basophilic cytoplasm
PB: small discrete blue cytoplasmic globules/blebs at the cytoplasmic margin (arrows)
PB: admixed small mature lymphocytes consistent with background CLL, plus a neutrophil
Inset: coarse granular (block-like) PAS positivity in blast cytoplasm
Tissue (H&E): sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei and a cell with an eosinophilic globule (arrow), adjacent to an area of small dark lymphocytes
18195.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing small blue cytoplasmic globules at the periphery, admixed with small mature lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils. A periodic acid-Schiff stain (inset) shows coarse granular cytoplasmic positivity in the blasts, supporting erythroid lineage. The tissue section shows sheets of large immature cells, one with an intracytoplasmic eosinophilic globule, juxtaposed with an area of small lymphocytes. In a patient with previously treated CLL, findings are consistent with a therapy-related erythroid (pure erythroid) leukemia coexisting with CLL; confirmation requires flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry for E-cadherin, CD71, and glycophorin, and cytogenetics (frequently complex with TP53 mutation).

ddx.vs: Richter cells are large B cells expressing CD19/CD20/PAX5 and lack PAS block positivity and erythroid markers (E-cadherin, CD71).
Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with condensed chromatin, a single prominent nucleolus, and pale cytoplasm, not deeply basophilic cytoplasm with blebs.
Megakaryoblasts also show basophilic cytoplasmic blebs but express CD41/CD61 and lack glycophorin/E-cadherin.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and express CD138/MUM1 without erythroid PAS pattern.

13267.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆大型細胞，細胞質形成厚實的紫色環狀邊緣，中間是一個大空泡，裡面是蒼白、顆粒狀的消化殘骸（已被分解的紅血球），代表「已完成」的吞噬紅血球現象；周圍還有數顆細胞質豐富、核圓的大型細胞。
features: Large central cell with a thick basophilic cytoplasmic rim surrounding a large phagocytic vacuole
Vacuole contains pale, granular, partially digested material (ghosts of ingested red cells)
Scattered large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
Background of numerous extravasated red cells and small dark nucleated cells (erythroid precursors/lymphocytes)
Poorly preserved, high-contrast section limits nuclear detail
13267.describe_en: Section (H&E) shows a cellular infiltrate with abundant red cells and small dark nucleated cells. Scattered large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and round, vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli are present. Centrally, a large cell with a thick cytoplasmic rim contains a large vacuole filled with pale granular debris, consistent with digested phagocytosed red cells. The image alone cannot establish lineage of the phagocytic cell; in the given context, findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma with tumor-cell erythrophagocytosis, which should be confirmed by CD30 and ALK immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: HLH histiocytes have bland small nuclei and are CD68/CD163-positive and CD30/ALK-negative, whereas ALCL cells are atypical and CD30-positive.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and engulf intact hematopoietic cells rather than digested red cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters and is keratin-positive, and melanoma is S100/SOX10-positive, whereas ALCL is CD30-positive and keratin-negative.
Histiocytic sarcoma expresses CD163/CD68 and lacks strong uniform CD30 and ALK.

12947.recognize_zh: 視野中滿是大型、核質發育不同步的顆粒球前驅細胞，包括馬蹄形大核的巨大後骨髓細胞與桿狀核（giant metamyelocytes/bands），並有細胞質深藍、核染色質細緻的大型紅血球前驅細胞，是巨母細胞性（megaloblastic）造血的表現，儘管血清 B12 值「正常」。
features: Numerous enlarged granulocytic precursors, including giant metamyelocytes and giant bands with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: open, immature chromatin in cells with mature granulated cytoplasm
Large erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and finely stippled (sieve-like) chromatin
Occasional hypersegmented neutrophils
Macrocytic and oval red cells with anisopoikilocytosis in the background
12947.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with prominent megaloblastic change. Granulocytic precursors are enlarged, with giant metamyelocytes and bands bearing large, horseshoe-shaped nuclei with immature chromatin. Erythroid precursors are large with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and finely dispersed, sieve-like chromatin, showing nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Background red cells include macro-ovalocytes. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis; given the clinical data (elevated methylmalonic acid and homocysteine, low holotranscobalamin, intrinsic factor antibodies), this represents vitamin B12 deficiency due to pernicious anemia despite a falsely normal serum B12 assay.

ddx.vs: MDS shows hypogranular and pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetics, and does not correct with vitamin replacement or show elevated MMA/homocysteine.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts and TP53 abnormalities rather than orderly megaloblastic maturation.
Drug effect is morphologically identical and is excluded by medication history and normal B12-related metabolites.
Folate deficiency raises homocysteine but not methylmalonic acid, whereas both are elevated in B12 deficiency.

12691.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆大型漿細胞（核偏心、細胞質深藍、核旁有淡染區）細胞質內可見數根細長針狀的結晶包涵體，看似 Auer 小體（pseudo-Auer rods），實為免疫球蛋白結晶；背景有數顆帶顆粒的骨髓前驅細胞。
features: Large plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus, clumped chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Paranuclear pale zone (hof) in the plasma cell
Several thin, needle-like, pink-purple crystalline rods within the plasma cell cytoplasm (pseudo-Auer rods)
Adjacent granulocytic precursors with eccentric nuclei and pink granular cytoplasm
Background of fat vacuoles and small dark nucleated cells
12691.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin, a paranuclear hof, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing several thin, needle-like crystalline inclusions resembling Auer rods. Surrounding granulocytic precursors and erythroid cells show no rod-like inclusions. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with intracytoplasmic immunoglobulin crystals (pseudo-Auer rods), in keeping with the reported IgG myeloma; plasma cell percentage, light-chain restriction by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry, and a screen for light-chain crystal-associated organ damage should be assessed.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with true Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in myeloblasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and MPO positivity, not in plasma cells with clumped chromatin and a hof.
APL faggot cells are hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and bundles of MPO-positive rods, with coagulopathy and PML::RARA fusion.
Crystal-storing histiocytes are macrophages with abundant cytoplasm packed with crystals and CD68/CD163 positivity rather than plasma cell morphology.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies or Mott cells
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are round globular immunoglobulin inclusions, not elongated needle-shaped crystals.

12563.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量中型淋巴球，核深度分葉成花瓣狀、像一朵花（flower cell / cloverleaf nucleus），染色質濃縮、胞質稀少，是 HTLV-1 相關成人 T 細胞白血病的典型型態。
features: Numerous medium-sized lymphoid cells with deeply lobulated, petal-shaped (flower/cloverleaf) nuclei
Nuclear lobes radiate around a central point, some with 4-6 lobes
Condensed, moderately coarse chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Scant, pale to faintly basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Marked lymphocytosis; background red cells without specific abnormality
12563.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of medium-sized atypical lymphocytes. The cells have scant agranular cytoplasm and polylobated nuclei with multiple petal-like lobes radiating from a center (flower cells), with condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Findings are characteristic of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation with HTLV-1 serology and T-cell immunophenotyping (CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei rather than discrete petal-shaped lobes, and patients are HTLV-1 negative with erythroderma.
T-PLL cells have a single prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, are often CD4+CD8+ and carry TCL1A rearrangement, lacking flower-shaped nuclei.
Neutrophils have lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments and pink granular cytoplasm, whereas flower cells have agranular basophilic cytoplasm and lobes clustered around a central point.

10707.recognize_zh: 下方母細胞的核在一側凹入，形成清楚的淡色杯口狀凹陷（cup-like nucleus / nuclear invagination），染色質細緻、胞質少且無顆粒，這種杯狀核母細胞與 NPM1 突變（常合併 FLT3-ITD）的 AML 高度相關。
features: Blasts with high N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin
Lower blast shows a prominent clear cup-like nuclear invagination occupying part of the nucleus
Upper blast oval with fine chromatin and a thin agranular cytoplasmic rim
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods visible
Red cells rendered in grayscale (image processing), limiting background assessment
10707.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. One blast displays a distinct cup-like nuclear invagination forming a clear, sharply outlined indentation, and the second blast has an oval nucleus with fine chromatin. Auer rods are not identified. The background has been digitally desaturated, limiting assessment of red cells and platelets. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology strongly associated with NPM1 mutation and FLT3-ITD; molecular testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL has bilobed butterfly nuclei and fine granules with coagulopathy and PML-RARA fusion, rather than a single cup-shaped invagination in an agranular blast.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded convoluted nuclei with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and NSE positivity, not a discrete clear cup-like pocket.

ddx.dx: AML with FLT3-ITD without NPM1 mutation
ddx.vs: Cup-like blasts can occur with FLT3-ITD alone, so morphology cannot distinguish them and NPM1 mutation analysis or NPM1 cytoplasmic IHC is required.

5843.recognize_zh: 視野中大量芽細胞，核染色質細緻、核仁明顯；中央一個芽細胞的細胞質空泡內包著一顆完整紅血球，把核擠成新月形，這就是芽細胞吞噬紅血球（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Numerous medium to large blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei and high N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin with one or more prominent nucleoli
Scant to moderate grey-blue cytoplasm, a few with fine granules or blebs
Central blast containing an intact engulfed red cell within a clear phagocytic vacuole, compressing the nucleus into a crescent
Crowded thick-area smear with many red cells and a few small dark nucleated cells
5843.describe_en: Smear shows a predominance of blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli and scant to moderate agranular to finely granular cytoplasm. One blast contains an intact red cell within a clear phagocytic vacuole, displacing the nucleus to a crescent (erythrophagocytosis by blasts). Mature histiocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with blast erythrophagocytosis; this feature should prompt evaluation for monocytic differentiation and KAT6A::CREBBP t(8;16)(p11.2;p13.3).

ddx.vs: This entity characteristically shows monocytic blasts with erythrophagocytosis, so cytogenetic testing is needed to separate it from AML without a defining genetic abnormality.
In HLH the phagocytes are mature benign macrophages with abundant cytoplasm and condensed nuclei, not blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli.
Emperipolesis occurs in large multilobated megakaryocytes and the enclosed cells are intact and viable, unlike a phagocytic vacuole within a blast.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia (AML with monocytic differentiation)
ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes may also phagocytose red cells; nonspecific esterase positivity and CD14/CD64/CD11b expression define monocytic lineage.

3091.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間兩顆無核小體，大小約紅血球的四分之一，中央紫色顆粒區、周邊淡染，形態一致，屬正常血小板。
features: Two small anucleate fragments roughly one quarter to one third the diameter of red cells
Central aggregate of purple azurophilic granules (granulomere)
Pale lavender peripheral hyalomere with smooth round to oval outline
No clumping, satellitism or giant forms
Background normocytic red cells, some slightly oval
3091.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows two platelets lying free between red cells. Each is round to oval, about one quarter to one third of a red cell diameter, with a central purple granulomere and a pale peripheral hyalomere. Granulation is normal, and there is no clumping or giant platelet formation. Findings are consistent with normal platelet morphology.

ddx.dx: Giant platelets (e.g. MYH9-related disorder, Bernard-Soulier syndrome)
ddx.vs: Giant platelets are as large as or larger than red cells, whereas these are about one quarter of a red cell diameter.

ddx.dx: Platelet lying over a red cell mimicking an intraerythrocytic parasite
ddx.vs: A platelet on top of a red cell shows a halo and granular texture without the ring cytoplasm and discrete chromatin dot of a Plasmodium trophozoite.

1939.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型圓形細胞，核佔大部分、染色質細緻顆粒狀篩網樣，周圍一圈深藍色嗜鹼性細胞質，是嗜鹼性巨母紅血球（basophilic megaloblast）；背景紅血球偏大、呈卵圓形巨紅血球（macro-ovalocytes），支持巨母細胞性貧血。
features: Large round erythroid precursor with high N:C ratio, finely granular open chromatin, and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm (basophilic megaloblast)
Additional megaloblastic erythroid precursors at various stages with open chromatin relative to cytoplasmic maturity
Enlarged myeloid precursor with abnormal nucleus at upper left and a multilobated neutrophil
Background red cells are large and oval (macro-ovalocytes)
Occasional small condensed late normoblasts for size comparison
1939.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows enlarged erythroid precursors, including a prominent basophilic megaloblast with a large round nucleus, finely granular open chromatin, and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Later-stage erythroid precursors retain open chromatin relative to their cytoplasmic maturation, and the background red cells are macro-ovalocytes. Enlarged granulocytic forms with abnormal nuclear lobation are also present. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.dx: Myeloblast or pronormoblast in acute leukemia
ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts form a monotonous expanded population with nucleoli, while here the large cell is part of a megaloblastic maturation spectrum with macro-ovalocytes and giant granulocytic forms.
Giant pronormoblasts are larger with prominent eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions and cytoplasmic blebs, and later erythroid stages are absent.
MDS shows megaloblastoid change with multilineage dysplasia and cytogenetic abnormalities, and does not respond to B12/folate replacement.

1235.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有數顆大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻均勻，胞質中等量淺藍、無明顯顆粒，旁邊有一顆正常分葉的中性球可作為大小比較；背景紅血球呈鋸齒狀假影。此圖顯示循環母細胞，但是否「有成熟」需骨髓判定。
features: Several large circulating blasts, larger than the adjacent segmented neutrophil
High N:C ratio with round to slightly angular nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm, agranular, with no visible Auer rods
One mature segmented neutrophil with normal lobation and granulation
Background red cells with crenation artifact
1235.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly angular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods are identified. A segmented neutrophil with normal lobation and granulation is present for comparison. Background red cells show crenation artifact. The findings indicate circulating blasts in keeping with acute leukemia; classification as acute myeloid leukemia with maturation requires bone marrow evaluation of granulocytic maturation and lineage confirmation.

ddx.vs: Agranular blasts without Auer rods cannot be assigned to a lineage morphologically, and MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry is required.
Peripheral blood blasts look the same, and the separation depends on whether the marrow contains >=10% maturing granulocytes.
Leukoerythroblastosis shows only rare blasts with nucleated red cells and left-shifted granulocytes, whereas several blasts in one field favor acute leukemia.

1299.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型組織球，細胞質淡灰藍而豐富，右側吞噬了一顆完整的有核細胞（周圍有透明吞噬泡），左側另有圓形核，是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）的直接證據。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Intact engulfed nucleated cell surrounded by a clear phagocytic vacuole (halo)
Round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin on the left side of the cell (histiocyte nucleus and/or additional ingested nucleus)
Few fine cytoplasmic granules; no crumpled or foamy texture
Background of cellular marrow with erythroid precursors, granulocytes and red cells
1299.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular marrow with maturing erythroid and granulocytic elements. A large histiocyte with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm contains an intact phagocytosed nucleated cell within a clear vacuole, together with additional round nuclei on the opposite side of the cell. This represents hemophagocytosis of a nucleated hematopoietic cell. Isolated hemophagocytosis is not specific, and a diagnosis of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis requires clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, soluble CD25, NK function). Findings are consistent with a hemophagocytic histiocyte.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a large multilobated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, and the enclosed cells are viable rather than degraded, unlike this histiocyte with a small oval nucleus.

ddx.dx: Binucleate or multinucleated plasma cell/erythroid precursor
ddx.vs: These have multiple nuclei in basophilic cytoplasm without a vacuole-enclosed intact cell.
Cannibalistic tumor cells show malignant nuclear features and cohesive clustering rather than a bland histiocytic nucleus.
Gaucher cells show fibrillar crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm without engulfed nucleated cells.

1171.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆大型組織球，核小而偏心，細胞質淡藍灰、豐富並有平行的纖維狀條紋（crumpled tissue paper 或 onion-skin 樣），與周圍造血細胞形成對比，是 Gaucher 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Several large histiocytes clustered together, much larger than surrounding hematopoietic cells
Low N:C ratio with small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei and coarse chromatin
Abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with parallel fibrillar striations ('crumpled tissue paper')
No discrete vacuoles or ingested cells in the striated cytoplasm
Background of myeloid precursors, neutrophils, erythroid cells, fat vacuoles and red cells
1171.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large histiocytes admixed with maturing myeloid and erythroid elements. The histiocytes have small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with fine, parallel fibrillar striations imparting a wrinkled tissue-paper appearance. No foamy vacuolation or phagocytosed cells are seen within these cells. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; correlation with glucocerebrosidase activity and GBA1 mutation analysis is recommended to exclude pseudo-Gaucher cells.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: They are indistinguishable by routine light microscopy; normal enzyme activity and the underlying disease establish the distinction.
Niemann-Pick cells have uniformly foamy soap-bubble vacuoles rather than fibrillar striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules instead of pale striated cytoplasm.

1107.recognize_zh: 大箭頭所指細胞的細胞質塞滿多顆淡藍色圓形小球（Russell bodies），像一串葡萄，即Mott細胞；右上小箭頭為漿細胞樣淋巴球，提示伴漿細胞分化的B細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Mott cell (large arrow) with cytoplasm packed with multiple pale blue, round, grape-like globules (Russell bodies)
Nucleus of the Mott cell partly obscured by the globules
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes (small arrows) with eccentric nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered pale blue globules free in the background from disrupted cells
Thick cellular aspirate with mixed small lymphoid and myeloid cells and fat spaces
1107.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with numerous small lymphoid and myeloid cells. A Mott cell is present (large arrow), with cytoplasm distended by numerous pale blue, round immunoglobulin inclusions (Russell bodies). Plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm are also seen (small arrows). These findings indicate plasmacytic differentiation and, in the context of a lymphoid infiltrate, are compatible with a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation such as marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a similar spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and Mott cells; MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein favor LPL over marginal zone lymphoma.
Myeloma consists of sheets of clonal plasma cells without a significant small B-lymphocyte component.
Reactive Mott cells occur among polytypic plasma cells without a clonal B-cell population on flow cytometry or light-chain studies.

4243.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血細胞與脂肪細胞交錯分布，可見紅血球系、顆粒球系細胞混雜，中央有一顆分葉核、細胞質豐富的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），屬正常三系造血的骨髓。
features: Hematopoietic cells interspersed between mature adipocytes, cellularity roughly 50-60%
Mixed population of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and granulocytic cells
Single megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, not clustered
Numerous interstitial red cells and small sinusoids
No sheets of blasts, fibrosis, granulomas or foreign cells
4243.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy section shows a normocellular marrow with hematopoietic tissue alternating with mature fat. There is a mixed trilineage population including erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytic cells and a single normal-appearing megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus. No increase in blasts, lymphoid aggregates, fibrosis or infiltrating non-hematopoietic cells is seen. Findings are consistent with normal adult bone marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis.

ddx.vs: MPN shows increased cellularity for age with clustered, atypical megakaryocytes, whereas here megakaryocytes are single and cytologically normal.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by small lymphocytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma forms monotonous interstitial or nodular aggregates of small lymphocytes, confirmed by CD20/CD5 IHC, rather than a mixed trilineage population.

4115.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，箭頭指出數個細胞質內含多個被吞噬有核細胞與碎屑的巨噬細胞，位於高細胞量骨髓小粒旁，提示噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Hypercellular marrow particle composed of densely packed hematopoietic/blast cells
Several macrophages (arrows) at the particle edge containing multiple engulfed nucleated cells and debris
Scattered individual large mononuclear cells with moderate cytoplasm in the surrounding smear
Low magnification prevents detailed blast cytology
4115.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular particle composed of densely packed hematopoietic cells. At the particle edge, several macrophages (arrows) contain multiple phagocytosed nucleated cells and debris, indicating hemophagocytosis. Scattered large mononuclear cells are present in the trails, but blast morphology cannot be fully evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis in a hypercellular marrow; in this case it is associated with acute monoblastic leukemia, and HLH criteria should be correlated clinically.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have large multilobated nuclei with granular cytoplasm rather than multiple discrete engulfed cells.
Artifactual clumps lack a surrounding shared macrophage cytoplasm; confirmation at high power is needed.
Infection-driven HLH lacks a leukemic blast population and may show organisms within macrophages.

4051.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的嗜中性球細胞核分成約 7 葉以上（正常 3–4 葉，≥6 葉即為過度分葉），細胞偏大，背景紅血球有些呈卵圓形，符合巨母細胞性貧血的過度分葉嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil）。
features: Enlarged neutrophil with at least 6-7 discrete nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin strands
Coarsely condensed chromatin within each lobe
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; no toxic granulation or Döhle bodies
Background red cells include several oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes)
No nucleated red cells or blasts in the field
4051.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large neutrophil with a markedly hypersegmented nucleus comprising at least six to seven lobes joined by fine chromatin filaments, with normal-appearing specific granules. Background red cells include oval macrocytes. Neutrophil hypersegmentation (one cell with six or more lobes, or more than 5% with five lobes) is an early and sensitive sign of impaired DNA synthesis. Findings are suggestive of megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency; correlation with MCV, vitamin levels, and methylmalonic acid is recommended.

ddx.vs: A benign inherited trait with hypersegmentation in otherwise normal counts and normocytic red cells, lacking macro-ovalocytes.
Morphology is identical, so medication history and normal B12/folate levels are needed to separate it.
Dysplastic neutrophils are more often hypogranular or hyposegmented (pseudo-Pelger-Huët) with cytopenias and other lineage dysplasia.
Occurs with microcytic hypochromic red cells or renal failure context rather than macro-ovalocytes.

4179.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指以及左下方的紅血球體積較大、沒有中央淡染區、染成灰藍色，這是殘存 RNA 造成的多染性紅血球（polychromatophilic red cell），代表網狀紅血球增加。
features: Several red cells larger than surrounding erythrocytes with a grayish-blue to lilac tint (arrow and lower left)
Polychromatophilic cells lack central pallor and have slightly irregular outlines
Background normochromic red cells with mild anisocytosis
Occasional echinocyte-like crenated red cell at upper right
Scattered platelets; no nucleated red cells or schistocytes in field
4179.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large red cells with a grayish-blue cytoplasmic tint and loss of central pallor, representing polychromatophilic red cells. The remaining red cells are largely normochromic with mild anisocytosis and an occasional crenated cell. Polychromatophilic red cells correspond to reticulocytes containing residual ribosomal RNA and indicate increased marrow erythropoietic activity. Findings are consistent with polychromasia, as seen in hemolysis or acute blood loss; a reticulocyte count and hemolysis markers are recommended.

ddx.vs: Stippled cells show discrete punctate blue granules on a normal-colored cell rather than diffuse blue-gray tint.
Spherocytes are small, dense and uniformly hyperchromatic without central pallor, not large and bluish.
Macrocytes are large but have normal pink hemoglobin coloration, and stomatocytes have a slit-like pallor.

3987.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒旁細胞量豐富，可見數顆大型多核巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）、各成熟階段的顆粒球（以桿狀與分葉嗜中性球為多）、紅血球系前驅細胞與散在淋巴球，無母細胞聚集或異常細胞群；三系造血完整且有序成熟，屬於成人反應性骨髓。
features: Cellular marrow particle region with fat spaces
Several large megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm
Granulocytic series at all maturation stages with abundant bands and segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and scattered small lymphocytes
No increase in blasts and no abnormal cell clusters
3987.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are readily identified and appear morphologically unremarkable at this magnification. Granulocytic precursors show orderly maturation with numerous bands and segmented neutrophils, suggesting a granulocytic predominance; erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes are also present. No increase in blasts or abnormal infiltrate is identified. Findings are consistent with a normocellular to hypercellular reactive marrow with preserved maturation.

ddx.vs: CML shows marked granulocytic expansion with a myelocyte peak, basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes, and requires BCR::ABL1.
MDS shows dysplasia such as hypolobated micromegakaryocytes, hypogranular neutrophils or megaloblastoid erythroid precursors, which are not evident here.
ET shows increased large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes in loose clusters; megakaryocyte number is best assessed on the biopsy.

3923.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在不定形、淡藍至紫色、雲霧狀或蠟樣的細胞外物質，周圍夾著造血細胞，這種無結構的沉積物即為類澱粉（amyloid）在抹片上的樣子。
features: Amorphous, pale blue to violet, waxy/cloud-like extracellular material in irregular clumps
Material lacks cellular structure and has smudgy, indistinct edges
Hematopoietic cells (maturing granulocytes, lymphocytes, erythroid precursors) adherent around the deposits
Background of blood with red cells; plasma cells not conspicuous in this field
3923.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows multiple irregular clumps of amorphous, pale blue to violet, waxy extracellular material with indistinct edges, admixed with hematopoietic cells. The material does not have a cellular or fibrillar architecture resembling stromal particles. Plasma cells are not conspicuous in this field. Findings are suggestive of amyloid deposition; confirmation by Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence on the biopsy and evaluation for a plasma cell neoplasm are recommended.

ddx.vs: Fibrin and stromal fragments are stringy or contain stromal cells and capillaries, whereas amyloid is homogeneous and Congo red positive.
Gelatinous transformation shows pink-purple mucopolysaccharide that is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative, with hypocellular marrow.
Stain precipitate is granular and refractile and lies on top of cells, not as smooth waxy masses surrounding them.
These are intracellular or crystalline aggregates within histiocytes rather than extracellular amorphous material, and are Congo red negative.

3731.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，紅血球聚成大小不一、邊界不規則的大團塊（agglutination），而非排成錢串，白血球散在其間，提示冷凝球蛋白或冷凝集素造成的紅血球凝集。
features: Red cells aggregated into large, irregular, three-dimensional clumps of varying size
Clumps have irregular 'map-like' outlines rather than linear stacked rouleaux
Scattered neutrophils visible between clumps
Intervening clear background with isolated single red cells and platelets
No visible extracellular precipitate at this magnification
3731.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows extensive red cell agglutination, with red cells forming large irregular clumps separated by clear spaces. The pattern differs from rouleaux, which forms linear stacks. Scattered neutrophils are present. Findings are consistent with in vitro red cell agglutination; in this setting a cryoglobulin (e.g., HCV-associated) or cold agglutinin should be considered, and warming the specimen to 37°C before smear preparation and repeat CBC is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear coin-stack arrays due to increased plasma proteins, whereas agglutinates are irregular clumps.
Morphology is identical, so direct antiglobulin test (C3d positive) and cold agglutinin titer versus cryoglobulin assay are required.
Overlap in thick areas is uniform near the head of the smear, whereas true agglutination persists as discrete clumps in the monolayer.

3795.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結被膜下方有數個淡染的結節狀副皮質區，夾在深藍色濾泡之間，形成明暗交錯的結構，結構仍保留，是皮膚病性淋巴結病的低倍特徵。
features: Lymph node with intact capsule and perinodal adipose tissue at the top
Superficial cortex shows pale-staining, nodular expansions of the paracortex alternating with darker lymphoid follicles
Pale zones composed of cells with abundant cytoplasm (histiocytes/dendritic cells) at low power
Deeper parenchyma densely lymphoid with small vessels; architecture preserved
Pigment not resolvable at this magnification
3795.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows preserved architecture with an intact capsule. The superficial cortex contains prominent pale-staining nodular expansions of the paracortex that alternate with darker lymphoid follicles, producing a mottled appearance. The deeper parenchyma is densely lymphoid without evident effacement. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; higher-power review for melanin-laden histiocytes and exclusion of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes are recommended.

ddx.dx: Lymph node involvement by mycosis fungoides/Sézary syndrome
ddx.vs: Involvement shows atypical cerebriform lymphocytes in clusters or sheets and partial effacement, supported by clonal TCR studies.
LCH is predominantly sinusoidal with eosinophils and necrosis rather than paracortical nodules with preserved sinuses.
Interfollicular CHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells within the expanded paracortex.

3603.recognize_zh: 中央細胞是雙葉核、細胞質佈滿大顆橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球（eosinophil），並非嗜中性球；核右側細胞質有一小片淡藍色、顆粒較少的區域，可能是杜勒小體，但不夠明確。左下另有一顆大型淡藍色血小板。影像與標題只部分吻合。
features: Eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and cytoplasm packed with coarse, refractile orange-red granules
Small pale blue, relatively agranular cytoplasmic area adjacent to the nucleus (possible Döhle body, not definitive)
No classic peripheral Döhle body in a neutrophil identified in this field
Large platelet with pale blue cytoplasm and central purple granules nearby
Normocytic red cells in background
3603.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus and abundant coarse orange-red granules. A small, pale blue, relatively granule-poor cytoplasmic area adjacent to the nucleus may represent a Döhle body, but it is not clearly separable from normal cytoplasm between granules. No neutrophil with a definite Döhle body is present in this field, so the image only partially illustrates the title. A large platelet and unremarkable red cells are also seen. Findings show an eosinophil with a possible Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusion; Döhle bodies are best assessed in neutrophils.

ddx.vs: A normal eosinophil has granules evenly distributed without a discrete pale blue agranular patch.
MYH9 inclusions are prominent, sharply outlined blue spindles in most granulocytes with giant platelets, unlike this equivocal pale area.

ddx.dx: Basophil or eosinophil with degranulation artifact
ddx.vs: Degranulated areas appear clear or vacuolated rather than homogeneously blue-gray.

3667.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒（particle）內滿是大小不一的脂肪空泡，箭頭指向一束細長紡錘形核、淡藍色細胞質拉成纖維狀的間質細胞（stromal/reticular cells），混雜造血細胞，屬骨髓正常間質成分而非腫瘤細胞。
features: Marrow particle with numerous variably sized fat vacuoles
Arrow: cluster of elongated spindle-shaped stromal cells with oval nuclei and wispy pale blue cytoplasm
Stromal cells arranged in a streaming, capillary-like strand between fat cells
Admixed hematopoietic cells and scattered dark hemosiderin-type granules
Thin eosinophilic fibrillary strands in background
3667.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a crushed particle composed of abundant adipocytes with interspersed hematopoietic cells. The arrow highlights a streaming strand of spindle-shaped stromal cells with oval nuclei and elongated, pale blue fibrillary cytoplasm, likely representing reticular/adventitial cells or capillary endothelium. No cohesive clusters of atypical epithelial or malignant cells are identified. Findings represent normal marrow stromal elements within an aspirate particle.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clumps with high N:C ratio, nuclear atypia, and nuclear molding rather than bland streaming spindle cells.
Spindle mast cells contain metachromatic purple granules and are tryptase/CD117 positive, unlike agranular stromal cells.
Fibrosis usually yields a dry tap with increased reticulin on biopsy, rather than a few spindle cells within an adequate particle.

3539.recognize_zh: 高倍下多數淋巴樣細胞核有深的切跡或裂溝，呈咖啡豆或臀狀（cleaved nuclei），細胞質稀少，染色質中度濃縮，是濾泡性淋巴瘤中心細胞在骨髓抹片的典型樣貌。
features: Small to medium lymphoid cells with scant pale-blue cytoplasm
Nuclei with deep clefts, notches, and indentations producing cleaved or buttock-like shapes
Moderately condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
A plasma cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm at left and a dark, densely stained tailed cell in the center
Scattered red cells; no normal myeloid maturation in this field
3539.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a population of small to medium lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and prominently cleaved, notched nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. An occasional plasma cell and a densely stained, possibly degenerated cell are also present. Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and trephine biopsy.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell nuclei are irregular but usually less deeply cleaved, and the tumor is CD5+ cyclin D1+ rather than CD10+ BCL6+.
Marginal zone cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with more abundant pale cytoplasm and are CD10-negative.
T-cell lymphoma cells show cerebriform or flower-shaped nuclei rather than single deep clefts and express T-cell markers.

3475.recognize_zh: 這是胸部電腦斷層（肺窗）橫切面，不是形態學切片：兩側肺野瀰漫性毛玻璃影與實質化，合併小葉間隔增厚，並有兩側背側胸水；影像型態不具特異性，需結合嗜中性球低下病史與微生物檢查才能判定為黴菌性肺炎。
features: Axial chest CT, lung window, at the level of the great vessels/carina
Bilateral extensive ground-glass opacities with areas of consolidation
Interlobular septal thickening producing a crazy-paving appearance in places
Bilateral dependent pleural effusions
No discrete halo-sign nodule or cavitation clearly identified on this single slice
3475.describe_en: Axial CT image of the chest in lung window shows extensive bilateral ground-glass opacities with patchy consolidation and interlobular septal thickening, together with bilateral dependent pleural effusions. No discrete nodule with a halo sign, air-crescent or cavitation is evident on this single slice. The pattern is nonspecific and can be seen with infection, edema, hemorrhage or drug toxicity. In a patient with drug-induced neutropenia, invasive fungal pneumonia is a consideration, but confirmation requires bronchoalveolar lavage, galactomannan/beta-D-glucan and histology or culture.

ddx.vs: PJP typically shows diffuse perihilar ground-glass with relative subpleural sparing and cysts, and is confirmed by BAL immunofluorescence or PCR.
Edema shows gravitational distribution with cardiomegaly or vascular redistribution and resolves with diuresis, without microbiologic evidence of fungus.
DAH shows progressively bloodier BAL aliquots and hemosiderin-laden macrophages, often with anemia and thrombocytopenia.
Classic angioinvasive aspergillosis presents with nodules showing a halo sign or later air-crescent cavitation rather than diffuse ground-glass alone.

3219.recognize_zh: 一顆細胞的細胞核碎裂成數個大小不一、深紫黑色且均質的圓球（核固縮 pyknosis／核碎裂 karyorrhexis），周圍仍保有粉紅色帶細顆粒的中性球細胞質，這是凋亡的中性球；背景紅血球呈錢串狀（rouleaux）。
features: Single cell of neutrophil size with pale pink finely granular cytoplasm
Nucleus fragmented into five to six round, dense, homogeneous dark purple spheres
Nuclear fragments are smooth-contoured and separated, without chromatin texture or connecting filaments
Intact cell membrane without phagocytosed material
Background shows prominent red cell rouleaux and scattered platelets
3219.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell rouleaux formation and adequate platelets. A single cell with neutrophil-type pale pink granular cytoplasm contains multiple round, dense, homogeneous dark nuclear fragments without discernible chromatin structure, consistent with pyknosis and karyorrhexis. The fragments are separate spheres rather than lobes connected by chromatin filaments. Findings are consistent with an apoptotic neutrophil, commonly a storage artifact of delayed smear preparation; the rouleaux should be correlated with serum protein studies if not explained clinically.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes with visible chromatin texture connected by thin filaments, not detached dense homogeneous spheres.

ddx.dx: LE cell or neutrophil with phagocytosed nuclear material
ddx.vs: An LE cell contains a large homogeneous ingested mass that displaces the cell's own intact lobulated nucleus to the periphery.
Erythroid karyorrhexis occurs in cells with hemoglobinized orange-grey cytoplasm and lacks neutrophilic granules.
Organisms are small, uniform, oval yeasts with a clear halo, whereas apoptotic fragments are larger, variable in size and solidly stained.

3347.recognize_zh: H&E 高倍率下，大型腫瘤細胞的細胞核呈腎形、馬蹄形或偏心分葉（hallmark cells），核仁明顯、染色質空泡狀，細胞質豐富淡染甚至呈泡沫狀，核旁偶有嗜酸性區域，並夾雜小淋巴球；這些 hallmark 細胞是 ALCL 的診斷線索。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale to amphophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm
Hallmark cells with eccentric kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nuclei and paranuclear eosinophilic region
Vesicular chromatin with one or more prominent nucleoli; occasional multinucleated or wreath-like forms
Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies present
Interspersed small mature lymphocytes and occasional eosinophils
Delicate intervening stroma with thin vessels
3347.describe_en: Section of lymph node at high power shows sheets of large pleomorphic neoplastic cells with abundant pale to amphophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. Many cells have eccentric horseshoe- or kidney-shaped nuclei with a paranuclear eosinophilic region (hallmark cells), vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, with occasional multinucleated forms. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified, and small lymphocytes and rare eosinophils are admixed. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; CD30 (strong, uniform) and ALK immunostains are required for classification.

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells have huge inclusion-like nucleoli within a polymorphous background, are CD15+/PAX5 weak+, and lack the sheet-like hallmark-cell population.
PTCL-NOS lacks uniform strong CD30 expression and hallmark cells and is ALK-negative.
Carcinoma cells are cytokeratin-positive and CD30/CD45-negative despite similar pleomorphism.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: The anaplastic DLBCL variant expresses B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5) and is ALK-negative.

3027.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片裡成片的中型芽細胞，核質比極高、細胞質少且無顆粒、染色質均勻細緻，部分核有凹痕或雙葉狀，旁邊可見少數殘存的顆粒球，符合兒童前 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Predominance of small-to-medium blasts, about 1.5-2 times RBC diameter
Very high N:C ratio with scant, agranular pale cytoplasm
Round to indented or cleaved nuclei with homogeneous finely dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli absent to inconspicuous; no Auer rods
Rare residual granulocytic precursor and a few mature cells; dark cell-border staining artifact
3027.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of small-to-medium sized blasts with a high N:C ratio and scant agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to indented, occasionally bilobed or cleaved, with homogeneous fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are present, and only rare residual granulocytic cells are seen. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry is needed to confirm precursor B-cell lineage (CD19, CD10, CD79a, TdT).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia (minimally differentiated or monoblastic)
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts tend to have more cytoplasm, visible nucleoli, granules or Auer rods, and express MPO/CD33/CD117 rather than CD19/CD10.
Hematogones form a small maturing continuum on flow without marrow replacement, unlike this sheet of monotonous blasts.
Morphology is indistinguishable; T-ALL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and often presents with a mediastinal mass and high WBC.

2963.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球系幾乎停留在前骨髓細胞（promyelocyte）與骨髓細胞階段，大量含粗顆粒的前驅細胞，卻幾乎看不到帶狀或分葉嗜中性球，呈現成熟停滯（maturation arrest），符合 Kostmann 症候群。
features: Numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes with round nuclei, visible nucleoli in some, and abundant azurophilic granules
Striking paucity of metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Admixed monocytoid cells and eosinophilic precursors
Scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
No blast sheets or Auer rods
2963.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field dominated by early granulocytic precursors, predominantly promyelocytes and myelocytes with abundant azurophilic granulation. Later stages, including metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, are strikingly scarce. Monocytoid cells, eosinophilic precursors, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are admixed, and there is no increase in blasts or Auer rods. Findings are consistent with maturation arrest of granulopoiesis at the promyelocyte/myelocyte stage, characteristic of severe congenital neutropenia (Kostmann syndrome).

ddx.vs: APL shows monotonous abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles and PML::RARA fusion, unlike these orderly precursors.

ddx.dx: Recovering marrow after chemotherapy or G-CSF
ddx.vs: A regenerating marrow shows a synchronous wave of early precursors that proceeds to mature forms within days.
Shwachman-Diamond usually shows a hypocellular marrow with dysplasia and pancreatic insufficiency rather than a pure promyelocyte arrest.

2899.recognize_zh: 視野中可比較：右上中性球顆粒密集（約 3 分），左上中性球只有稀疏細小藍點（約 1 分），右下中性球無藍色顆粒（0 分），中左圓核細胞為淋巴球，不列入評分。
features: Upper right neutrophil with dense blue granules over red nucleus (about 3+)
Upper left neutrophil with sparse fine blue granules (about 1+)
Lower right band/segmented neutrophil without granules (0)
Round-nucleated lymphocyte (left) with no reaction product, excluded from scoring
2899.describe_en: High-power view of a leukocyte alkaline phosphatase-stained peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with differing reactivity. One neutrophil has dense blue granules (approximately 3+), another has only sparse fine granules (approximately 1+), and a third lacks reaction product (0). A lymphocyte with a round red nucleus is present and is not included in the count. This field illustrates the per-cell grading used to derive the LAP score.

ddx.vs: 4+ cells show confluent precipitate that completely obscures the nucleus, not seen here.
Monocytes have a single folded nucleus and are excluded from the LAP score even if weakly stained.

2707.recognize_zh: 中央一顆紅血球的下緣聚集了一小串深藍紫色、細點狀的顆粒，只集中在細胞邊緣一側——這種成簇、偏周邊的顆粒正是 Pappenheimer 小體的典型表現。
features: Single red cell with a small cluster of dark blue-purple granules at one edge
Granules few, coarse and grouped rather than diffusely distributed
Some pale hypochromic red cells and ghost-like cells in the field
Remaining red cells normochromic with central pallor
No overlying platelet halo around the granules
2707.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a predominantly normochromic red cell population with scattered pale hypochromic cells. A central red cell contains a small cluster of dark basophilic granules localized to one side of the cell periphery. The granules are grouped rather than evenly distributed, arguing against basophilic stippling. Findings are consistent with Pappenheimer bodies; Prussian blue stain would confirm iron-containing siderocytes.

ddx.vs: Stippling granules are numerous and scattered uniformly across the whole red cell and do not stain with Prussian blue.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round, larger dense inclusions rather than a cluster of fine dots.
Heinz bodies are not visible on Wright stain and require supravital stain (crystal violet), appearing as larger inclusions attached to the membrane.

2643.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片一小群大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、部分可見核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍色、無顆粒，形態偏大且不似典型小型淋巴母細胞，須配合流式細胞儀才能確認為難治性ALL。
features: Cluster of large blasts with moderate size variation
Moderate N:C ratio with a moderate rim of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Small but visible nucleoli in several cells
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules; occasional cells with irregular nuclear contours
Background of red cells, fat vacuoles and scattered platelets
2643.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an aggregate of large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small but visible nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale-blue, agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified, and maturing myeloid or erythroid elements are not evident in this field. The blasts are larger and have more cytoplasm than classic small lymphoblasts, so lineage cannot be assigned on morphology alone. In the stated context, findings are consistent with persistent (refractory) acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry and MRD assessment are needed to confirm.

ddx.vs: Large blasts with visible nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm overlap with myeloblasts, so MPO and flow cytometry are needed to exclude a myeloid or lineage-switched process.
Recovery marrow shows a mixed, maturing population of promyelocytes, erythroid precursors, and hematogones rather than a cohesive monotonous blast population.
Tumor cells form tight cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are negative for CD45 and TdT/CD19, while leukemic blasts are discohesive at the edges and CD45 positive.

2579.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中，紅血球之間到處是成群聚集的血小板，數量明顯增加且大小不一，白血球為形態正常的嗜中性球，符合原發性血小板增多症（ET）。
features: Markedly increased platelets forming multiple clusters and aggregates across the field
Platelet anisocytosis with scattered large platelets
Two morphologically normal segmented neutrophils
Red cells largely normocytic without teardrop cells or nucleated red cells
No blasts or immature granulocytes in this field
2579.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in platelets, present both singly and in numerous clusters, with variation in platelet size including occasional large forms. Two segmented neutrophils are morphologically unremarkable. Red cells show no significant poikilocytosis, and no teardrop cells, nucleated red cells, immature myeloid cells or blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with marked thrombocytosis, compatible with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Reactive thrombocytosis (iron deficiency, inflammation, asplenia) has uniform normal-sized platelets and lacks driver mutations, often with microcytosis or Howell-Jolly bodies pointing to the cause.
CML shows leukocytosis with a left shift, myelocyte bulge and basophilia and is BCR-ABL1 positive.
Prefibrotic PMF may show leukoerythroblastosis and teardrop cells and has hypercellular marrow with atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes on biopsy.
EDTA-induced clumping is associated with a low automated count, whereas true thrombocytosis shows increased platelets throughout, including single platelets.

2451.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片中成群的原始細胞，核圓或輕度不規則、胞質少，混有小型深染細胞，中央可見一個有絲分裂像，殘存少數中性球；呈原始細胞增生，符合 ALL（T 細胞系需流式確認）。
features: Clusters and sheets of blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin; occasional nucleoli
Scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm
Mitotic figure in the center of the field
Admixed small dense lymphoid/erythroid cells and rare segmented neutrophils
2451.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm, admixed with small dense cells and rare segmented neutrophils. A mitotic figure is present. Normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry is needed to confirm T-lymphoblastic lineage.

ddx.vs: Separated only by immunophenotype (CD19/CD79a vs cytoplasmic CD3).
AML blasts typically have more cytoplasm with granules or Auer rods and express MPO.

ddx.dx: Small round cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma) in marrow
ddx.vs: Metastatic small round cell tumors form cohesive clumps or rosettes and lack TdT and hematolymphoid markers.

2195.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 中，脂肪細胞周圍被一圈中型、核不規則深染的淋巴球緊密環繞（rimming），間質內並有核碎裂（karyorrhexis）碎屑與組織球，是皮下脂膜炎樣 T 細胞淋巴瘤的典型表現。
features: Atypical lymphoid cells rimming individual adipocytes
Small-to-medium cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei
Moderate pale to clear cytoplasm
Scattered karyorrhectic nuclear debris and apoptotic bodies
Admixed histiocytes; infiltrate confined to fat lobules
2195.describe_en: Sections of subcutaneous adipose tissue at high power show a dense infiltrate of small-to-medium atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei and pale cytoplasm. The atypical cells characteristically rim individual adipocytes. Scattered karyorrhectic debris and admixed histiocytes are present, while plasma cells are not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma; confirmation with a CD8+, TCR-beta-F1+, cytotoxic (TIA-1/granzyme B) and TCR-gamma negative phenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lupus panniculitis shows lymphoid follicles, abundant plasma cells, hyaline fat necrosis and mixed CD4/CD8 cells without cytologically atypical rimming CD8+ cells.
PCGD-TCL also rims fat but typically involves dermis and epidermis, is TCR-gamma positive, CD4/CD8 double negative, and has a worse prognosis.
NK/T-cell lymphoma shows angiocentric destruction and is EBER positive, whereas SPTCL is EBV negative.

2067.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成片中型、形態一致的腫瘤細胞，核圓、染色質細緻並帶數個小核仁，細胞質少且邊緣因收縮呈方正（squared-off）排列，並可見分裂像與淡染的吞噬細胞，符合 Burkitt 淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with nuclei similar in size to histiocyte nuclei
Round nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and multiple small, paracentral nucleoli
Scant amphophilic cytoplasm with retraction artifact producing squared-off, cobblestone cell borders
Mitotic figure and apoptotic bodies present
Scattered pale tingible-body macrophages contributing to a starry-sky appearance
2067.describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely clumped chromatin and multiple small nucleoli. The cells have scant amphophilic cytoplasm with squared-off borders due to retraction. Mitotic figures, apoptotic bodies and scattered pale tingible-body macrophages are present. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma; confirmation by CD10+/BCL6+/BCL2-, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement is recommended.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger and more variable with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, often BCL2 positive with Ki-67 below 90%.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: It can be morphologically identical and is separated by BCL2 expression and FISH showing BCL2 rearrangement.
Lymphoblasts have finer, dusty chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli and are TdT positive, whereas Burkitt cells are TdT negative.

1875.recognize_zh: 視野中央的中性球細胞核分成約六個以上、以細絲相連的核葉（≥6 lobes），即過度分葉中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil），常提示維生素 B12 或葉酸缺乏；背景紅血球有錢串狀排列（rouleaux）。
features: Neutrophil of normal to slightly enlarged size
Nucleus with six or more discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments
Condensed chromatin in each lobe
Pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Background red cells show rouleaux formation; scattered platelets
1875.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil whose nucleus is divided into six or more discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments, with fine neutrophilic granules in the cytoplasm. Red cells in the background show rouleaux formation, and platelets are present. Although a single cell is not diagnostic, a neutrophil with six or more lobes is abnormal. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation, suggestive of megaloblastic anemia (vitamin B12 or folate deficiency) and warranting correlation with MCV and vitamin levels.

ddx.vs: This rare benign autosomal dominant trait shows hypersegmentation without macrocytosis or cytopenias, with normal B12 and folate levels.
Drug-induced megaloblastic change looks identical morphologically and is distinguished by medication history.

ddx.dx: Overlapping neutrophils or lobe counting artifact
ddx.vs: Lobes should be counted only when separated by thin filaments; overlapping or folded lobes can mimic extra segments.
