1811.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（上方可見脂肪空泡）被成片的大型異型細胞取代，核為正常淋巴球的數倍大、呈泡狀並有明顯核仁，細胞質中等量、淡嗜雙色，並散見有絲分裂像，符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的骨髓浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large atypical cells with nuclei several times the size of a small lymphocyte
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with one or more distinct nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic to pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with discernible cell borders
Scattered mitotic figures and occasional apoptotic cells
Fat spaces at the top; brown-black granular pigment deposits (likely formalin pigment or hemosiderin); normal hematopoiesis not seen
1811.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows effacement of the intertrabecular marrow space by diffuse sheets of large atypical cells. The cells have round to oval vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli, moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and scattered mitoses. Residual normal hematopoiesis is not identified in this field, and brown-black granular pigment deposits are noted. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a large cell lymphoma, compatible with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20, PAX5, CD10, BCL6, MUM1, Ki-67) is required to confirm lineage and exclude mimics.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells are cohesive with nested growth and are keratin- or S100/SOX10-positive and CD45/CD20-negative.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or anaplastic plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Cells show eccentric nuclei with plasmacytoid cytoplasm and are CD138/MUM1-positive and CD20/PAX5-negative.
Blasts have finer chromatin with less vesicular nuclei and express CD34/CD117/MPO rather than B-cell markers.
Includes horseshoe-shaped hallmark cells and is strongly CD30-positive with T-cell or null phenotype.

1619.recognize_zh: Giemsa 染色下一個大型圓形濾泡：中央為較淡、細胞較大且疏鬆的生發中心，外圍被一圈深藍、密集的小淋巴球外套區包圍，右上角為纖維被膜，是正常次級濾泡的經典低中倍圖。
features: Round secondary follicle with a pale germinal center of larger cells with vesicular nuclei
Scattered clear spaces and macrophages within the germinal center
Surrounding rim of densely packed small dark-blue lymphocytes (mantle zone)
Fibrous capsule at the upper right
Interfollicular small lymphocytes and vessels at the left
1619.describe_en: Giemsa-stained section of lymph node at medium power shows a large round secondary follicle beneath the capsule. The germinal center consists of loosely arranged larger cells with vesicular nuclei and scattered macrophages, and is surrounded by a well-defined mantle zone of densely packed small lymphocytes. The interfollicular area contains small lymphocytes and vessels. Findings are consistent with a normal secondary lymphoid follicle.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are crowded, uniform in size with attenuated mantles and few macrophages, and are BCL2 positive by IHC.
NLPHL nodules are larger and composed of small lymphocytes with scattered LP cells rather than a pale germinal center surrounded by a mantle.

1427.recognize_zh: 這是部分核型圖（非型態圖）：左為正常 5 號與長臂缺失的 del(5)(q11q33)，右為正常 7 號與 del(7)(q11q36)，箭頭指出短縮的衍生染色體；5q 與 7q 同時缺失屬於 MDS 的不良預後核型。
features: Partial G-banded karyogram of chromosome pairs 5 and 7
Arrow on chromosome 5 highlights a markedly shortened long arm consistent with del(5)(q11q33)
Arrow on chromosome 7 highlights loss of most of the long arm consistent with del(7)(q11q36)
Labels below state del(5)(q11q33) and del(7)(q11q36)
Image resolution is low; fine band-level detail cannot be assessed independently
1427.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic cytogenetic figure showing a partial G-banded karyogram. For chromosome 5, the normal homolog is paired with a derivative chromosome showing loss of most of the long arm, labeled del(5)(q11q33); for chromosome 7, the normal homolog is paired with a derivative showing loss of the long arm, labeled del(7)(q11q36). The co-occurrence of del(5q) with del(7q) excludes the category of MDS with isolated del(5q) and places the karyotype in a poor-risk group. The findings support a clonal myelodysplastic syndrome in the stated context of multilineage dysplasia.

1491.recognize_zh: 這是胸部 X 光正面片（非型態圖）：心臟陰影明顯擴大、呈燒瓶狀，雙側下肺野有網狀間質陰影與肋膈角變鈍；在 CMML 病人中需考慮漿膜腔積液（如心包膜積液）或肺部浸潤等髓外表現。
features: Frontal (PA/AP) chest radiograph
Markedly enlarged, globular cardiac silhouette
Bilateral increased interstitial/reticular markings, more pronounced at the lung bases
Blunting of the costophrenic angles suggesting small pleural effusions
Radiopaque ring-shaped external object over the right upper hemithorax (external artifact)
1491.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic image: a frontal chest radiograph. The cardiac silhouette is markedly enlarged with a globular configuration, and there are bilateral interstitial reticular opacities predominantly at the bases with blunting of the costophrenic angles, suggesting small pleural effusions. A ring-shaped external radiopaque object overlies the right upper chest. In a patient with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, a globular cardiac silhouette raises concern for pericardial effusion, and serosal effusions or pulmonary infiltration are recognized extramedullary manifestations; echocardiography and fluid cytology would be needed to confirm this.

60307.recognize_zh: 視野中散在帶有直線切緣與尖角的紅血球碎片，包括半月形的頭盔細胞（helmet cells）與三角形的三角細胞（triangulocytes），並缺乏中央淡染區，符合裂紅血球（schistocytes）。
features: Multiple red cell fragments with straight cut edges and sharp angular corners
Helmet cells (keratocyte-like fragments with two horn-like projections) and triangular fragments (triangulocytes)
Fragments are smaller and denser than intact red cells, lacking central pallor
Occasional crenated red cells and small dense microspherocytic forms
Only a single platelet seen in this field, raising concern for thrombocytopenia (count should be confirmed)
60307.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of normocytic red cells with numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells and triangulocytes with straight edges and pointed ends, as well as occasional microspherocytes and crenated cells. Platelets appear sparse in this field. No agglutination or nucleated red cells are seen. Findings are consistent with red cell fragmentation, as seen in microangiopathic hemolytic anemia (e.g. TTP, HUS, DIC) or mechanical valve hemolysis; correlation with platelet count, LDH, haptoglobin and ADAMTS13 is recommended.

ddx.vs: Bite cells retain most of the cell with a smooth semicircular defect, whereas helmet cells and triangulocytes are small fragments with straight edges and sharp corners.
Echinocytes are intact round cells with evenly spaced short projections, not angular fragments.
HPP shows extreme microcytosis with budding, fragments and elliptocytes in a congenital setting, and does not come with thrombocytopenia.
Sickle cells are elongated crescentic intact cells with two pointed ends rather than angular fragments.

147.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被單一型態、中等大小、染色質細緻且核分裂多的淋巴母細胞瀰漫取代；流式顯示 CD45dim、cytoCD3+、CD7 強陽性、CD4−/CD8−、CD1a−、CD5 弱，並表現 CD13/CD33 等骨髓系標記，符合早期 T 前驅（ETP）表型的 T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Lymph node architecture effaced by a diffuse, monotonous sheet of lymphoid cells extending to the capsule
Intermediate-sized cells with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed (blastic) chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Numerous mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic debris
IHC: diffuse strong nuclear positivity in one stain (pattern consistent with TdT) and diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous positivity in T-cell-type stains; panel antibodies are not labeled on the figure
Flow cytometry (CD45dim gate): cytoplasmic CD3+, bright CD7+, CD4-/CD8- (double negative), CD1a-, dim/partial CD5, partial CD10, partial CD13 and CD33, dim HLA-DR, CD56 subset
CT neck: multiple enlarged, conglomerate left cervical lymph nodes
147.describe_en: Contrast-enhanced CT images show extensive, conglomerate left cervical lymphadenopathy. The excised lymph node shows complete effacement of the architecture by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of intermediate-sized cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and frequent mitotic figures. Immunohistochemical stains (antibody labels not shown on the figure) demonstrate diffuse nuclear positivity consistent with TdT and diffuse expression of T-cell-associated markers. Flow cytometry of the CD45-dim population shows cytoplasmic CD3 and bright CD7 expression, lack of CD4, CD8 and CD1a, only dim/partial CD5, and aberrant expression of the myeloid markers CD13 and CD33 with dim HLA-DR. Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic lymphoma with an early T-cell precursor (ETP) immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so separation requires flow cytometry: non-ETP T-LBL usually expresses CD1a and/or CD8 and brighter CD5 without stem-cell or myeloid markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia/myeloid sarcoma with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Myeloid sarcoma lacks cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT-positive T-lineage commitment and may show MPO or lysozyme positivity, whereas this tumor is cCD3-positive.
B-LBL shows the same blastic cytology but expresses CD19, CD79a and PAX5 and is negative for cytoplasmic CD3.
Burkitt cells are mature CD20+/CD10+ B cells with a starry-sky pattern and near-100% Ki-67 but are TdT-negative, unlike this TdT-positive T-lineage population.

147.stain: H&E; IHC (unlabeled panel); flow cytometry; CT
captions: CT neck (coronal and axial): extensive conglomerate left cervical lymphadenopathy
Lymph node H&E, low to high power: diffuse effacement by monotonous intermediate-sized blasts with frequent mitoses
IHC panel: scattered positive cells in A-C; diffuse strong nuclear staining in D (pattern consistent with TdT)
IHC panel: diffuse positivity for T-cell-associated/lineage markers with variable intensity
Flow cytometry: cCD3+, CD7 bright, CD4-/CD8-, CD1a-, dim CD5, partial CD13/CD33, dim HLA-DR (ETP phenotype)

83.recognize_zh: 真皮被大量胞質呈細泡沫狀（xanthomatous）、核小而溫和的組織球取代，伴隨纖維化、零星淋巴球聚集，並可見核排成花環狀的 Touton 型多核巨細胞；免疫染色組織球顆粒狀陽性（組織球標記），配合臨床骨硬化病灶即符合 Erdheim-Chester disease。
features: Dermal infiltrate of sheets and clusters of foamy (xanthomatous) histiocytes with finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Small, bland round to oval histiocyte nuclei without atypia, nuclear grooves or mitoses
Touton-type multinucleated giant cells with a wreath of nuclei
Background dermal fibrosis with collagen bundles separating histiocytes and small perivascular lymphocytic aggregates
Granular cytoplasmic immunostaining of foamy histiocytes (histiocytic marker such as CD68/CD163; label not provided)
83.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows an overlying unremarkable epidermis and a dermis that is diffusely hypercellular and fibrotic at low power. Higher magnification reveals sheets of foamy xanthomatous histiocytes with finely vacuolated cytoplasm and small, bland nuclei, admixed with Touton-type multinucleated giant cells, collagen fibrosis and scattered small lymphocytic aggregates. Nuclear grooves, emperipolesis, eosinophil-rich infiltrates and cytologic atypia are not seen. An immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled) shows granular cytoplasmic positivity in the foamy histiocytes, consistent with a histiocytic marker. In the context of bilateral sclerotic long-bone lesions and systemic infiltrates, findings are consistent with Erdheim-Chester disease; CD1a/langerin negativity and BRAF V600E testing would further support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Histology and immunophenotype (CD68+/CD163+/factor XIIIa+, CD1a-) overlap, so the distinction rests on clinical-radiologic context (systemic disease, symmetric long-bone osteosclerosis) and BRAF V600E status.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei, eosinophilic rather than foamy cytoplasm, admixed eosinophils and are CD1a+/langerin+, unlike these CD1a-negative foamy histiocytes.
RDD histiocytes are large with pale non-foamy cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli, emperipolesis and strong S100 positivity.

ddx.dx: Reactive xanthoma / xanthomatous inflammation (e.g., xanthelasma, necrobiotic xanthogranuloma)
ddx.vs: May be morphologically indistinguishable; necrobiotic xanthogranuloma shows necrobiosis and cholesterol clefts with paraproteinemia, and reactive xanthomas lack BRAF/MAPK mutations and systemic bone disease.

83.stain: H&E; IHC (histiocytic marker, label not shown)
captions: Low power H&E: skin biopsy with hypercellular, fibrotic dermis beneath unremarkable epidermis
H&E: foamy histiocytes and Touton-type giant cells in fibrotic dermis
High power H&E: xanthomatous histiocytes with bland nuclei between collagen bundles
H&E: sheets of foamy histiocytes with fibrosis and a small lymphoid aggregate
High power H&E: finely vacuolated cytoplasm and small bland nuclei
IHC (histiocytic marker): granular cytoplasmic positivity in foamy histiocytes

19.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成片的大型不成熟細胞，胞質豐富灰藍帶細顆粒與空泡、核呈摺疊或腎形，屬單核球分化（monoblast/promonocyte）；切片為高細胞性，細胞核卵圓至扭曲；搭配乳癌化療病史與 t(6;11)(q27;q23)/KMT2A 重排，符合治療相關急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Aspirate: sheets of large immature cells with moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, fine azurophilic granules and scattered vacuoles
Nuclei round to folded, indented or reniform with delicate lacy chromatin and variably visible nucleoli (monoblasts and promonocytes)
PB: circulating blast with fine chromatin and a bilobed neutrophil with coarse chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-like)
Biopsy: hypercellular marrow effaced by sheets of immature cells with oval to folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm; rare megakaryocyte
19.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast with fine chromatin and a bilobed, hypogranular-appearing neutrophil suggestive of a pseudo-Pelger-Huet form. The bone marrow aspirate contains sheets of large immature cells with moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, fine azurophilic granules, occasional vacuoles and round to folded or reniform nuclei with delicate chromatin, consistent with monoblasts and promonocytes. The core biopsy is hypercellular and effaced by sheets of immature cells with oval to folded nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, with few residual megakaryocytes. Auer rods are not identified in the fields shown. Given the history of cytotoxic chemotherapy for breast cancer two years earlier and t(6;11)(q27;q23) with KMT2A rearrangement, findings are consistent with therapy-related acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: De novo AML with t(6;11)/KMT2A::AFDN (AML with KMT2A rearrangement)
ddx.vs: Morphology and genetics can be identical; the prior cytotoxic therapy history is what assigns this case to the therapy-related category.

Microgranular APL has bilobed folded nuclei but is strongly MPO positive with bright CD33, CD34/HLA-DR negative and PML::RARA, whereas monocytic blasts are nonspecific esterase positive with CD14/CD64/CD11b and KMT2A rearrangement.
CMML has mostly mature monocytes with fewer than 20% blasts plus promonocytes, while this marrow is replaced by sheets of monoblasts and promonocytes.
t-MDS shows prominent multilineage dysplasia with fewer than 20% blasts and is typical of alkylator exposure with -5/-7, whereas this case is overt leukemia with a balanced 11q23 translocation.

captions: Peripheral blood: circulating blast and a bilobed pseudo-Pelger-like neutrophil
Aspirate high power: monoblasts and promonocytes with folded nuclei, gray-blue granular cytoplasm and vacuoles
Aspirate: sheets of monocytic blasts with abundant cytoplasm and indented nuclei
Core biopsy H&E: hypercellular marrow effaced by immature cells with oval to folded nuclei

61651.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中滿是異常前骨髓細胞（abnormal promyelocytes）：細胞質充滿粗大紫紅色顆粒，核呈雙葉或「蝴蝶形」並有凹陷，部分可見核仁，視野中有細長棒狀結構疑似 Auer rods；這是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的經典形態。
features: Sheets of large abnormal promyelocytes replacing normal marrow elements
Nuclei bilobed, reniform or folded (butterfly/sliding-plate shapes), with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli
Abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic (purple-red) granules, often obscuring the nuclear border
Slender rod-like structures in the background suggestive of Auer rods (released from disrupted cells)
Occasional cell with basophilic cytoplasm and few granules; background granular debris from ruptured cells
61651.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly increased population of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules. Nuclei are frequently bilobed, folded, or reniform with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli. Scattered slender rod-like inclusions consistent with Auer rods are seen, and the background contains granular debris from disrupted cells; normal maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and evaluation for coagulopathy are warranted.

ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have a prominent perinuclear Golgi hof, round eccentric nuclei, lack faggot cells, and are followed by orderly maturation.
t(8;21) AML shows myeloblasts with single long Auer rods, salmon-colored cytoplasm, and perinuclear hofs rather than hypergranular bilobed promyelocytes, and is CD34/HLA-DR positive.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have grey-blue cytoplasm with sparse fine granules and are non-specific esterase positive, whereas APL cells are strongly MPO positive and CD34/HLA-DR negative.

60179.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中脂肪細胞大量佔據、造血組織只剩細窄條索（低細胞性），其中可見數顆小型巨核細胞，核圓形、不分葉或分葉很少（hypolobated/monolobated），是發育不良巨核細胞的線索；紅血球系與顆粒球系仍可見。
features: Hypocellular marrow with predominance of adipocytes and thin cords of hematopoietic tissue
Megakaryocytes small to medium-sized with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei (dysplastic forms)
Megakaryocyte nuclei with open chromatin and small nucleoli, surrounded by moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Trilineage hematopoiesis present: erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei and granulocytic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
No clusters of blasts or fibrosis evident in this field
60179.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E) shows a hypocellular marrow with abundant adipocytes and narrow cords of residual hematopoietic tissue. Trilineage hematopoiesis is present, including erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytic cells. Several megakaryocytes are small with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei, consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia. No blast aggregates or fibrosis are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome with single lineage (megakaryocytic) dysplasia, in the appropriate clinical and cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a hypocellular marrow without megakaryocytic dysplasia and with markedly reduced or absent megakaryocytes, rather than preserved dysplastic hypolobated forms.
del(5q) MDS also has small hypolobated megakaryocytes but is usually normo- to hypercellular and defined by the 5q deletion on cytogenetics.
Hypocellular AML shows ≥20% blasts, often highlighted by CD34 immunostaining, which are not seen here.
